title: Recruitment Specialist - Remote
description:
Please follow the application instructions below



Role Overview



We are seeking a proactive and results-driven Remote Recruiter to join our growing team. This role is responsible for managing the full recruitment lifecycle, from sourcing and screening candidates to coordinating interviews and supporting hiring managers throughout the selection process. The ideal candidate has experience recruiting from scratch, utilizing various job portals, CRM systems, and Applicant Tracking Systems (ATS) to identify and attract top talent across multiple industries and positions.



Key Responsibilities

Recruitment & Talent Acquisition



Full-Cycle Recruitment: Manage end-to-end recruitment processes, from job posting and candidate sourcing to offer negotiation and onboarding support.

Candidate Sourcing: Identify qualified candidates through job portals, social media platforms, professional networks, referrals, and direct outreach.

Resume Screening: Review and evaluate applications to shortlist candidates based on role requirements and qualifications.

Candidate Interviews: Conduct phone and video screenings to assess skills, experience, and cultural fit.

Interview Coordination: Schedule and coordinate interviews between candidates and hiring managers while ensuring a positive candidate experience.

Talent Pipeline Development: Build and maintain talent pools for current and future hiring needs.



CRM, ATS & Recruitment Systems Management



CRM Management: Maintain accurate candidate records and communication history within CRM systems.

ATS Administration: Utilize Applicant Tracking Systems to manage candidate workflows, track recruitment progress, and maintain compliance.

Database Management: Update and organize candidate profiles, interview notes, and recruitment documentation.

Reporting & Analytics: Generate recruitment reports and provide hiring insights to support decision-making.



Job Portal & Employer Branding



Job Posting Management: Create, publish, and optimize job advertisements across multiple job boards and recruitment platforms.

Platform Utilization: Effectively leverage Indeed, LinkedIn, JobStreet, OnlineJobs.ph, Hireology, and other sourcing platforms.

Employer Branding: Promote the company's employer brand through professional candidate engagement and recruitment marketing initiatives.

Candidate Engagement: Maintain consistent communication with applicants throughout the recruitment process.



Stakeholder Collaboration



Hiring Manager Partnership: Collaborate closely with hiring managers to understand hiring requirements and recruitment priorities.

Recruitment Strategy: Develop sourcing strategies to attract high-quality candidates for difficult-to-fill positions.

Process Improvement: Identify opportunities to streamline recruitment workflows and improve hiring outcomes.



Required Skills & Experience

Recruitment Expertise



Proven experience in full-cycle recruitment and talent acquisition.

Experience recruiting from scratch for various roles and industries.

Strong understanding of sourcing techniques, candidate screening, and interview processes.

Ability to manage multiple vacancies simultaneously while meeting hiring deadlines.



Technical Requirements

Experience using major job portals such as LinkedIn, Indeed, JobStreet, OnlineJobs.ph, Hireology, and similar platforms.

Professional Skills

title: SEO Specialist
description:
We are looking for an experienced SEO Specialist who can lead and manage our full SEO workflow, with a strong focus on Local SEO, Search Atlas, technical SEO coordination, gap analysis, and ongoing campaign maintenance.



This role is ideal for someone who understands how to improve local search visibility, support Google Business Profile growth, organize SEO tasks, and coordinate execution across content, technical SEO, and development teams.



Work Schedule:

9:00 PM to 5:00 AM Manila Time



Role Overview

The SEO Specialist will be responsible for planning, leading, monitoring, and improving SEO campaigns for multiple clients. This person should be able to identify ranking opportunities, create structured SEO workflows, review local SEO performance, conduct gap analysis, and ensure that all SEO tasks are completed properly and consistently.



The ideal candidate must have advanced experience using Search Atlas and must be confident in managing SEO strategy from planning to execution.



Key Responsibilities:



Local SEO Strategy

Develop and manage local SEO strategies to improve client visibility in Google Search and Google Maps. This includes Google Business Profile optimization, local keyword targeting, service area strategy, citation direction, local content planning, and competitor review.



Overall SEO Workflow Leadership

Lead the overall SEO workflow from strategy creation to execution. Coordinate SEO tasks, organize priorities, assign action items when needed, and make sure each campaign follows a clear process.



Gap Analysis

Conduct SEO gap analysis across websites, competitors, keywords, content, backlinks, Google Business Profiles, citations, and technical SEO areas. Identify what competitors are doing better and create action plans to close the gap.



Monitoring and Maintenance

Monitor campaign performance, rankings, website health, Google Business Profile activity, keyword movement, technical issues, and recurring SEO tasks. Maintain SEO campaigns through regular audits, updates, and optimization checks.



Search Atlas Management

Use Search Atlas for keyword research, content planning, site audits, competitor analysis, optimization recommendations, backlink insights, and reporting. The candidate must be comfortable using Search Atlas at an advanced level.



Technical SEO Coordination

Review and identify technical SEO issues such as crawl errors, indexing issues, page speed concerns, metadata problems, heading structure issues, broken links, schema opportunities, internal linking gaps, and site architecture concerns. Coordinate with developers when technical fixes are needed.



Content and On Page SEO Direction

Guide content optimization by reviewing keyword placement, heading structure, internal links, metadata, page intent, local relevance, and overall SEO richness. Provide clear direction to copywriters when content needs improvement.



Reporting and Documentation

Prepare SEO updates, campaign notes, task summaries, ranking observations, and performance reports. Keep workflows organized and easy for the team to follow.



Must Have Qualifications

- Advanced experience using Search Atlas

- Strong background in Local SEO

- Experience leading SEO workflows or managing SEO campaigns

- Ability to conduct competitor and gap analysis

- Knowledge of Google Business Profile optimization

- Strong understanding of on page SEO and technical SEO

- Experience with keyword research and local keyword mapping

- Ability to monitor rankings, performance, and campaign progress

- Clear communication skills

- Organized, detail oriented, and proactive



Preferred Qualifications

- Experience working with service based local businesses

- Experience with Google Search Console and Google Analytics

- Familiarity with citation building and local directory strategy

- Understanding of schema markup

- Experience coordinating with copywriters, developers, and operations teams

- Familiarity with SEO reporting tools and project management tools

- Ability to create SOPs or structured SEO workflows



Skills Needed

- Local SEO strategy

- Search Atlas

- Keyword research

- Competitor analysis

- Gap analysis

- Google Business Profile optimization

- On page SEO

- Technical SEO

- Internal linking strategy

- Content optimization

- SEO reporting

- Workflow management

- Team coordination



What We Are Looking For

We are looking for someone who does not just complete SEO tasks, but can think strategically, lead the process, spot problems, and recommend the next best action. The right person should be able to look at a campaign and clearly understand what needs to be fixed, improved, prioritized, or monitored.



This role requires someone who is reliable, analytical, organized, and comfortable managing SEO work across multiple clients.



How to Apply

Please send your resume along with a short summary of your SEO experience, especially your experience with Search Atlas, Local SEO, Google Business Profile optimization, and SEO workflow management.



Applicants with proven experience handling local SEO campaigns and advanced Search Atlas usage will be prioritized.

title: Full time AI video creator
description:
Hiring: AI Content Creation VA (Short-Form Video)



We are a social media content company that creates short-form video content for health and wellness brands on Instagram. We use AI tools to generate images, voiceovers, talking head videos, and motion clips, then edit everything together into finished Instagram Reels.



This is a long-term position, not a one-time project.



What you will be doing:



- Using AI tools to generate realistic images of characters (Nano Banana Pro)

- Generating natural sounding voiceovers (ElevenLabs)

- Creating talking head videos (HeyGen)

- Generating motion video clips (Google Veo 3)

- Editing everything together into polished short-form videos (CapCut or your preferred editing software)

- Using Claude AI to write prompts and improve your work quality



You do not need prior experience with these specific tools. We have a full 9-stage onboarding program that trains you on everything step by step. But you do need to be someone who learns fast and pays attention to detail.



What we are looking for:



- Reliable and consistent. You show up every day and communicate if something comes up. This is the number one thing we care about.

- Detail-oriented. The difference between a good video and a bad one comes down to small details.

- Coachable. You take feedback seriously and apply it to your next video.

- Has their own laptop or desktop computer with a stable internet connection.

- Has their own video editing software (CapCut works great).

- Can follow instructions carefully without needing to be told the same thing twice.



Schedule:



Monday through Saturday. Daily check-in at 9:00 AM PHT. All work for the day must be completed and submitted by 9:00 PM PHT.



Pay:



$500 per month.

mber, do not apply.

title: Creator Onboarding & Affiliate Coordinator (CRM + Shopify)
description:
Are you detail-oriented, process-driven, and comfortable managing multiple tools to onboard creators into a brand's affiliate program?

We're hiring a Creator Onboarding Coordinator to manage the full post-qualification pipeline — from sending contracts to getting creators fully set up and active in our affiliate system.

This is not a creative role. This is an operations role.

You will be managing contracts, setting up affiliate profiles, coordinating product shipments, and confirming Meta Partnership Ads access — all while keeping the CRM pipeline clean and up to date.

If you're the type of person who loves checklists, follows up relentlessly, and never lets a ball drop — read on.

What You'll Be Doing



Monitor the Go High Level (GHL) pipeline for creators who reach "Ready to go" status

These creators have already been qualified by our outreach team — your job starts here

Manage contract delivery:



Contracts are auto-sent via GHL/PandaDoc when status changes

You follow up on unsigned contracts (48h reminder, then personal follow-up)

Answer any questions creators have about the contract terms

Confirm contract is signed and move GHL status forward





Set up creators in UpPromote (Shopify affiliate app):



Add creator to the affiliate program

Ensure unique affiliate/discount code is generated

Send creator their portal login and code





Coordinate product delivery:



Ship product to creator OR confirm they used their discount code to self-purchase

Track shipment and confirm receipt

Update GHL status at each step





Handle Meta Partnership Ads (whitelisting) setup:



Send the Partnership Ads request from our Meta Ads Manager

Guide the creator through accepting the request in their Instagram app

Confirm access is live in Ads Manager





Send content brief once the creator has received the product and whitelisting is confirmed

Move creator to "Active" status — handoff to our ad ops/creative team



Output Expectations (Very Important)

This role requires careful pipeline management, not speed.

You should be comfortable managing:



15–25 creators in active onboarding at any given time

Processing 5–10 new "Ready to go" creators per week

Daily pipeline review — no creator should sit in a status for more than 48h without action

100% follow-through — every creator who signs a contract must reach "Active" status



You must be:



Thorough

Organized

Relentless with follow-ups

Comfortable managing multiple tools simultaneously



If something is stuck, you flag it. You don't wait.

Must-Have Skills



CRM management:



Comfortable with pipeline-based CRMs (Go High Level preferred, but similar tools work)

Tagging, status updates, follow-up scheduling, contact notes





Shopify basics:



Navigating Shopify admin to manage affiliate app (UpPromote)

Processing or confirming orders

You don't need to be a Shopify developer — just comfortable in the admin panel





Contract/document management:



Experience with PandaDoc, DocuSign, or similar e-signature tools

Following up on unsigned documents without being pushy





Clear written communication:



Professional, friendly English for creator-facing messages

Ability to explain simple technical steps (e.g., "how to accept Partnership Ads in Instagram")





Process management:



You can manage a checklist of 5–6 steps per creator without missing any

You keep clean notes in the CRM

You escalate issues before they become blockers







Bonus (Nice to Have)



Experience with affiliate marketing platforms (UpPromote, Refersion, GoAffPro, etc.)

Familiarity with Meta Business Manager or Ads Manager

Understanding of influencer/creator onboarding workflows

Previous work in DTC or e-commerce operations

Experience with Go High Level specifically



Who You Are



You're a natural operator — you love systems and processes

You're the person who follows up when others forget

You can manage 5 different tools without getting confused about what goes where

You communicate clearly when something is blocked or needs attention

You're reliable, consistent, and take ownership of your pipeline

You understand that your job is to get creators from "interested" to "active" with zero drop-off



Job Details



Hours: 20–30 hrs/week (negotiable, may increase as volume grows)

Long-term position

Fully remote

Payment: Monthly salary (based on experience)



How to Apply (Important)

???? Apply only via OnlineJobs.ph

When applying, you MUST include:



A short description of any operations, onboarding, or CRM management work you've done before

Any experience with Shopify, affiliate platforms, or contract management tools

Your expected monthly salary

Your availability (hours/week + timezone)



???? Subject line:

"Creator Onboarding Coordinator — CRM + Shopify"

Applications without relevant experience description will not be reviewed.

title: Staff Accountant
description:
About Liberty Horizons

Liberty Horizons is a financial consulting and venture capital practice based in Toronto, Canada. We build and manage accounting and finance operations for founder-led startups and small businesses, handling fractional CFO services, bookkeeping, AR/AP, payroll, and venture consulting. We are a small, high-standard team. That means real ownership, real exposure, and real growth for the right person.



This is not a role for someone who wants to process transactions and clock out. It is a role for someone who takes pride in the quality of their work, holds themselves to a high standard without being asked, and wants to build something alongside a team that genuinely cares about the businesses they serve.



About the Role

The Staff Accountant owns the day-to-day financial operations of the firm and its clients: full-cycle bookkeeping, payroll, tax compliance, reconciliations, and reporting. You are the operational backbone of the finance team. The Senior Financial Controller relies on you to keep everything clean, accurate, and on time, and to surface problems before they compound.



Responsibilities

Bookkeeping and General Ledger



Maintain accurate financial records including general ledger entries and supporting documentation

Perform full-cycle bookkeeping: accounts payable, accounts receivable, invoicing, payments, and expense reimbursements

Reconcile bank accounts, credit cards, and balance sheet accounts on a regular cadence

Analyze account activity, investigate variances, and resolve discrepancies without being asked



Financial Reporting



Prepare monthly, quarterly, and annual financial statements: balance sheet, income statement, and cash flow reports

Update and maintain internal financial trackers in Google Sheets

Assist with month-end and year-end close processes, on time, every time



Payroll and Tax Compliance



Support payroll processing including payroll entries, remittances, and related filings

Assist with tax compliance and filings including corporate and payroll taxes

Ensure all filings meet regulatory deadlines without exception



Systems and Records



Maintain organised electronic records: receipts, invoices, digital files, and compliance documents

Use and maintain cloud-based accounting systems, primarily QuickBooks Online, and spreadsheets for reporting and analysis

Ensure compliance with company policies, accounting standards, and regulatory requirements



Communication and Collaboration



Communicate proactively with internal teams; updates sent before they are requested

Surface problems early, with context and a proposed resolution, not just a flag

Operate as a reliable, low-maintenance tea
mber in a fully remote environment



What an A-Player Looks Like in This Role



Output quality: Every reconciliation, report, and filing is clean before it reaches anyone else. You do not submit work you would not put your name on permanently.



Ownership: When something in your area goes wrong, you surface it immediately, own it fully, and come with a fix. Your manager does not follow up on the same thing twice.



Accuracy: You catch errors before they become problems. Attention to detail is not a trait you claim; it is observable in everything you produce.



Proactivity: You identify inefficiencies, flag risks, and propose improvements without waiting to be asked.



Systems thinking: You fix root causes, not symptoms. When a recurring error appears, you build something to prevent it from happening again.



Communication: Written communication is clear, structured, and specific. You confirm understanding before acting and follow up without being chased.



Digital fluency: You are genuinely comfortable in a fully remote, cloud-based environment. Tools are not a barrier; they are how you work.



Values: You do the right thing when no one is watching. You treat every client's money and time as if it belonged to someone you love.



Who This Role Is For

Someone who takes genuine pride in clean, accurate financial work

Someone who operates with a high degree of personal accountability; no deflection, no excuses

Someone who is comfortable in ambiguity and moves fast without losing quality

Someone who is digitally native and thrives in a remote, fully virtual environment

Someone who wants to grow into more responsibility, more complexity, and more ownership over time

Someone who understands startup culture and finds it energising, not overwhelming



Who This Role Is Not For

Someone who needs a lot of direction to know what good looks like

Someone who treats compliance as a ceiling rather than a floor

Someone who waits to be asked before flagging a problem

Someone who is technically adequate but has no interest in growing beyond that

Someone who finds remote, fast-moving environments stressful rather than motivating



Qualifications

Must Have



2+ years of experience in an accounting environment

2+ years of hands-on experience with QuickBooks Online

Degree (or equivalent) in Accounting, Finance, or a related field

Strong working knowledge of Microsoft Excel and Google Sheets

Solid understanding of general accounting principles and financial reporting standards

Exceptional attention to detail, evidenced not just claimed

Strong written and verbal English communication skills

Proven ability to manage deadlines independently in a remote environment

Nice to Have



Experience with Xero, Wave, ADP, or Knit People

Prior experience in a startup, fractional CFO, or multi-client accounting environment

Experience building or improving financial tracking systems in Google Sheets



What We Offer

Full-time remote role with genuine flexibility

Direct exposure to a diverse portfolio of founder-led businesses

A small, high-standard team where your work is visible and your contribution matters

Real growth potential in a company that is actively building

A culture where merit drives advancement, not tenure or politics



The Hiring Process

This process is deliberate and thorough. We are selective because the standard matters, to us and to our clients.



Screening Call: A 45-minute video call covering your experience, values, and fit for the role

Hiring Manager Interview: A deeper conversation on role-specific competency, ownership, and how you work

Final Interview: Values and leadership assessment with senior leadership

Reference Checks: Minimum two professional references, at least one direct manager

description:
Job Overview

We are a fast-growing, innovative brand, and we are looking for a highly capable, resourceful, and proactive Online Reputation Management (ORM) Specialist. You will take complete ownership of our digital footprint, from managing our presence on forums like Reddit to building a fortress of positive reviews on Trustpilot and Google, all with the ultimate goal of ensuring we show up flawlessly in AI search engines (ChatGPT, Perplexity, Gemini, etc.).



If you are someone who waits to be told exactly how to handle a negative brand mention or needs step-by-step instructions on review generation, this is not the role for you. We need a tactical, results-focused professional who knows how to scrub the internet of unfair negativity, drown out the noise with high-quality positive content, and engineer our brand’s narrative across the modern web.



Core Responsibilities

- Forum & Reddit Management: Actively monitor brand mentions across Reddit and niche forums. Strategically mitigate, suppress, or facilitate the removal of negative comments and threads (utilizing ToS flags, moderation outreach, and strategic counter-narratives).

- Review Generation Mastermind: Build, execute, and manage systems to drive glowing reviews across platforms like Trustpilot, Google Reviews, Sitejabber, and industry-specific directories.

- Positive Content Proliferation: Distribute positive articles, PR, blog posts, and user-generated content across high-authority sites to ensure the first page of our search results is overwhelmingly positive.

- AI Search Engine Optimization: Structure and seed positive brand content across the web so that large language models (ChatGPT, Perplexity, Gemini) generate accurate, highly favorable summaries of our brand.

- Monitoring & Reporting: Utilize brand monitoring tools to track sentiment, keyword visibility, and review velocity. Provide weekly updates on what’s ranking, what’s changing, and how our AI search presence is improving.



Required Qualifications & Skills

- Experience is Mandatory: You must have a proven track record of successfully suppressing/removing negative search results and significantly boosting positive brand sentiment.

- Platform & Policy Expertise: You understand the complex ecosystems and moderation guidelines of Reddit, Trustpilot, and Google. You know the exact levers to pull to get unfair or defamatory content removed or pushed down.

- SEO & AI Search Intuition: You understand how traditional search engines and new AI search tools scrape, summarize, and prioritize information.

- Exceptional Communication Skills: Flawless written English. You can write persuasive outreach
s, manage forum accounts organically, and craft brand-aligned responses to customer feedback.

- Proactive Problem-Solver: You naturally spot a negative link or a dip in Trustpilot score and immediately execute a multi-step plan to fix it without being asked.

- Reliable Setup: High-speed internet connection (with a backup plan) and a reliable computer capable of handling multiple workflows smoothly.



How to Apply:

If you are sharp, highly strategic, and ready to take full ownership of our brand's digital reputation, please reply with:

- A brief introduction outlining your experience specifically with Reddit reputation management and Trustpilot/Google review generation.

- A brief case study or example (redacted if necessary) of a time you successfully suppressed a negative search result/thread or rapidly improved a brand's online rating.

title: Reddit Reputation Specialist
description:
Job Overview

We are a fast-growing, innovative brand, and we are looking for a highly tactical and resourceful Reddit Reputation Specialist. Reddit is often the first place consumers look for honest feedback, and it is a primary data source for modern AI search engines (ChatGPT, Perplexity, Gemini). We need a specialist to take complete ownership of our brand’s narrative on this platform.



If you think marketing on Reddit means spamming promotional links from brand-new accounts, or if you need to be told how to handle a viral negative comment, this is not the role for you. Redditors are notoriously anti-marketing. We need a stealthy, hyper-aware professional who understands Reddit culture, knows exactly how to get unfair negative content removed, and can strategically seed positive narratives that look and feel 100% organic.



Core Responsibilities

- Negative Content Suppression & Removal: Actively monitor all brand mentions. Use a deep understanding of Reddit’s Terms of Service (ToS) and individual subreddit rules to report, suppress, or facilitate the removal of defamatory, false, or purely malicious threads and comments.

- Organic Narrative Seeding: Cultivate positive brand discussions. You will strategically inject positive mentions, reviews, and recommendations into relevant subreddits without raising the "corporate shill" alarm.

- Crisis Management & Rapid Response: Be the first line of defense if a negative thread starts gaining traction. Deploy immediate counter-narratives, clarification posts, or strategic upvote/downvote mechanics to control the damage.

- Trend & AI Monitoring: Track how our Reddit sentiment is impacting our overall SEO and AI search results, providing weekly reports on sentiment shifts, thread rankings, and risk assessments.



Required Qualifications & Skills

- Deep Reddit Expertise is Mandatory: You must be a veteran of the platform. You understand karma thresholds, account aging, shadowbans, astroturfing detection, and the unique culture/humor of different subreddits.

- Proven ORM Experience: You have a track record of successfully getting negative Reddit posts removed, locked, or pushed down in search results.

- Impeccable English & Nuance: Your writing must be flawless, conversational, and highly adaptable. You must know how to write like a real user, not a PR robot.

- Knowledge of Reddit’s Reporting Ecosystem: You know exactly which reporting levers to pull (e.g., harassment, copyright/DMCA, self-harm, breaking sub rules) to trigger automated or manual admin/mod actions.

- Proactive "Fixer" Mentality: You don't wait for a crisis to happen. You are constantly searching for brand mentions, competitor mentions, and industry keywords to stay two steps ahead.

- Reliable Setup: High-speed internet connection, a reliable computer, and an understanding of operational security (VPNs, clean IPs, browser fingerprinting) to manage multiple touchpoints safely.



How to Apply:

If you are a tactical problem-solver ready to defend and grow our brand on the internet's most critical forum, please reply with:

- A brief explanation of the exact steps you take when you find an unfair, highly upvoted negative thread about a brand you represent.

- An example (redacted if necessary) of a time you successfully had a negative Reddit post removed or completely turned the sentiment of a hostile thread around.

title: Full Time Dispatcher
description:
About the Role



We are seeking a highly motivated and experienced Dispatcher with a positive attitude and excellent communication skills. The ideal candidate will have expertise in load negotiation, scheduling, and route planning, while adhering to DOT and ELD regulations.



Vehicles Being Dispatched



26-Foot Box Trucks (10,000 lb weight capacity) – Dock-high with lift gate

Sprinter Vans / Cargo Vans / Ram ProMaster (High Roof)



About Us



Eveready Express is a well-established leader in the trucking, courier, logistics, and distribution industries, founded in 1984. We pride ourselves on honesty, integrity, and mutual respect.



Key Responsibilities

Dispatching Vehicles



Negotiate rates with drivers while aiming for a minimum 40% margin, and assign vehicles to specific routes and deliveries based on customer orders, schedules, and driver availability.



Communication with Drivers



Maintain constant communication with drivers by providing instructions, updates, and support throughout their routes.



Routing and Scheduling



Plan efficient routes to minimize travel time, fuel costs, and vehicle wear. Adjust schedules as needed to accommodate changes or unexpected events.



Tracking Shipments



Monitor shipments in real time using tracking systems and GPS technology. Address delays or issues as they arise.



Customer Interaction



Serve as the primary point of contact for customers after dispatch, providing delivery updates, addressing inquiries, and resolving concerns or complaints promptly.



Documentation



Maintain accurate records of trucking activities, including driver logs, delivery schedules, and customer communications. Ensure compliance with company policies and regulations (e.g., BOL, POD).



Problem-Solving



Resolve logistical problems or emergencies such as vehicle breakdowns, traffic delays, or adverse weather conditions.



Safety Compliance



Ensure trucks and drivers comply with safety regulations and company policies. Regularly verify driver credentials, vehicle maintenance, and adherence to transportation laws in collaboration with HR.



Team Collaboration



Work closely with Customer Service, Fleet Drivers, Billing, Sales, HR, and Warehouse staff to coordinate operations and improve efficiency.



Continuous Improvement



Identify and suggest improvements to dispatching processes, customer satisfaction, and operational efficiency. Offer feedback and innovative solutions to the management team.

Bid on Sylectus, DAT, Amazon Relay, and other broker platforms during the off-peak season.

• At least 2 years of experience in the U.S. logistics industry, with proven experience in dispatching, logistics coordination, or transportation management.



• Strong verbal and written communication skills, with the ability to effectively interact with drivers, customers, and tea
mbers.



• Excellent organizational and multitasking skills, with strong attention to detail and the ability to prioritize tasks in a fast-paced environment.



• Proficiency in dispatching software, GPS systems, and other relevant technology tools.



• Knowledge of transportation regulations, safety procedures, and industry best practices.



• Ability to remain calm under pressure, with a problem-solving mindset and flexibility to adapt to changing circumstances.



• Availability to work irregular hours, including evenings, weekends, and holidays, to ensure 24/7 coverage.



Hardware & Technical Requirements



• Processor: 2.0 GHz or higher (Intel Core i5/i7 preferred)

• RAM: Minimum 8 GB

• Disk Space: 100 GB of free space

• A second monitor for multitasking

• Backup computer

• Noise-canceling headset

• Internet: Minimum 20  Mbps wired connection for both primary and backup ISPs

• USB sticks are not allowed for backup ISP connections



Perks of the Job



• Competitive weekly salary

• Opportunity to receive HMO benefits

• Opportunities for advancement within the company



To Apply



Please send an
 with the subject line:

to

 must include:

• A PDF copy of your resume

• A screenshot of your internet speed test from speedtest.net



Please follow all instructions above. Only applicants who demonstrate genuine interest in the role will be considered.



If selected, you will be invited to a brief

title: Walmart Operations Lead
description:
Zoyava is a fast-growing digital-native supplement brand focused on building premium wellness products that consumers genuinely love. As we continue scaling across major eCommerce marketplaces, Walmart Marketplace has become a key strategic growth channel for the business.



We are looking for a highly experienced Walmart Operations Lead to take ownership of Walmart Marketplace performance, drive operational excellence, and help scale the channel into a major revenue driver for the company.



This is a leadership role for someone who understands Walmart deeply, thinks strategically about growth, communicates clearly with leadership, and can build scalable systems across catalog, advertising, inventory, promotions, and reporting.



Who We’re Looking For



We’re seeking a highly analytical, growth-oriented operator with deep Walmart Marketplace experience who can lead the day-to-day operations and long-term strategy of the Walmart channel.



This role is ideal for someone who has successfully scaled brands on Walmart Marketplace, understands Walmart Connect advertising, knows how to improve operational performance, and can proactively identify growth opportunities while keeping leadership informed through strong reporting and business insights.



You should be comfortable owning the Walmart business like it’s your own.



Key Responsibilities



Walmart Marketplace Ownership



• Lead and oversee all Walmart Marketplace operations across the brand.

• Own channel growth, revenue performance, profitability, and operational execution.

• Develop and execute Walmart growth strategies focused on sales expansion, margin improvement, and market share.

• Manage end-to-end catalog operations including listings, variations, compliance, SEO, inventory health, and pricing. • Ensure all listings are optimized for discoverability, conversion, and Walmart algorithm performance.

• Monitor account health, policy compliance, suppression risks, and operational KPIs.



Walmart Growth & Strategy



• Identify new opportunities for growth through assortment expansion, promotions, pricing strategies, search visibility, and advertising optimization.

• Analyze category trends, competitor activity, and Walmart platform changes to maintain competitive advantage.

• Develop launch strategies for new products and ensure successful execution on Walmart Marketplace.

• Drive initiatives that improve conversion rate, traffic, ROAS, contribution margin, and repeat purchase behavior.



Walmart Connect Advertising



• Lead Walmart Connect advertising strategy and execution.

• Oversee campaign structure, keyword targeting, bidding strategy, budget allocation, and scaling decisions.

• Continuously optimize ad efficiency and profitability through data analysis and testing.

• Report on advertising performance, attribution, TACOS, ROAS, and growth opportunities.



Leadership Reporting & Business Insights

title: Remote Wazuh Security Monitoring Specialist
description:
Preferred Candidate Location: Philippines



## Position Type



Part-Time Contractor



## About the Role



AI Hub is looking for a remote Wazuh Security Monitoring Specialist to help set up, manage, monitor, and maintain Wazuh security monitoring environments for business clients.



This role is for someone who understands Wazuh, security monitoring, log analysis, endpoint monitoring, alert review, and basic technical reporting.



The right person should be comfortable working with Wazuh agents, Wazuh server, indexer, dashboards, alerts, logs, vulnerability data, file integrity monitoring, configuration assessment, and basic i
 review workflows.



This is not a general virtual assistant role. This is a technical security monitoring role.



## About Wazuh



Wazuh is an open-source security monitoring platform used for endpoint detection and response, SIEM and log management, vulnerability detection, file integrity monitoring, configuration assessment, cloud security monitoring, container security monitoring, and compliance reporting support.



The specialist we hire must be able to work inside Wazuh, understand alerts, review security activity, and help document what is happening in the monitored environment.



## Main Responsibilities



* Set up and configure Wazuh environments under the manager's direction

* Install and help manage Wazuh agents on approved endpoints

* Monitor Wazuh dashboards for alerts, issues, and unusual activity

* Review endpoint activity, log data, vulnerabilities, configuration findings, and file integrity alerts

* Check agent status and confirm endpoints are reporting properly

* Review Wazuh alerts and identify items that need manager attention

* Prepare clear monitoring reports for management

* Document findings, actions taken, and open issues

* Help maintain Wazuh rules, dashboards, reports, and monitoring workflows

* Follow internal security, access control, and documentation procedures

* Escalate high-risk alerts or unclear findings to management

* Support client monitoring tasks for cloud, on-premise, or hybrid environments when assigned



## Required Skills



* Hands-on experience with Wazuh

* Basic understanding of SIEM and log management

* Basic understanding of endpoint detection and response

* Experience reviewing security alerts and system logs

* Familiarity with Linux servers

* Familiarity with Windows endpoint monitoring

* Understanding of Wazuh agents, server, indexer, and dashboard

* Ability to document technical findings clearly

* Ability to follow checklists and standard operating procedures

* Strong attention to detail

* Reliable communication

* Comfortable working remotely with task tracking and reporting tools



## Preferred Skills



* Experience with cloud security monitoring

* Experience with AWS, Azure, or Google Cloud logs

* Experience with Docker or container monitoring

* Experience with vulnerability detection workflows

* Experience with file integrity monitoring

* Experience with compliance reporting support for PCI DSS, HIPAA, SOC 2, NIST, or similar frameworks

* Experience creating or reviewing technical reports

* Experience with ticketing tools such as Jira, ServiceNow, ClickUp, Trello, or similar tools



## Important Role Boundaries



This role supports security monitoring, documentation, and escalation.



This role does not make final legal, compliance, audit, or certification decisions.



This role does not guarantee that any client is compliant with HIPAA, PCI DSS, SOC 2, NIST, GDPR, or any other standard.



The specialist will help monitor technical controls, document findings, and escalate items for manager review.



## Work Schedule



This is a part-time remote role.



Expected schedule:



* 10 to 20 hours per week to start

* Monday through Friday availability preferred

* Daily monitoring check-ins required on assigned workdays

* Weekly reporting required

* Additional hours may be available based on workload and performance



The final schedule will be confirmed before hiring.



## Example Work Routine



A typical workday may include:



* Check Wazuh dashboard health

* Confirm active agents are connected

* Review new alerts

* Review vulnerability or configuration findings

* Identify urgent issues for escalation

* Update the monitoring tracker

* Prepare a short daily report

* Attend a short manager check-in when needed



## Compensation



Compensation will be discussed during the hiring process based on experience, technical skill level, schedule availability, and assigned responsibilities.



Payment schedule will be confirmed before work begins.



Possible payment structure may include:



* Hourly part-time pay

* Weekly or biweekly payment schedule

* Optional performance review after a trial period



No bonus, raise, or long-term hours are guaranteed. Any future increase or expanded responsibility must be approved by management.



## Who This Role Is Best For



This role is a good fit for someone who:



* Has real Wazuh experience

* Enjoys cybersecurity monitoring work

* Can follow technical checklists

* Can explain alerts in simple language

* Is reliable with daily reporting

* Can work independently

* Knows when to escalate instead of guessing

* Wants consistent part-time technical work



## Who Should Not Apply



Please do not apply if:



* You have never used Wazuh

* You are not comfortable reviewing security alerts

* You cannot work with Linux or endpoint monitoring tools

* You cannot provide clear daily updates

* You are looking for a non-technical virtual assistant role



## How to Apply



Please send the following:



1. Your resume or work profile

2. A short summary of your Wazuh experience

3. Examples of Wazuh tasks you have handled

4. Your experience with Linux, Windows, cloud, or container monitoring

5. Your available work schedule

6. Your expected hourly rate

7. Your preferred payment schedule

8. Any screenshots or sample reports you are allowed to share, with private client data removed



## Screening Questions



Please answer these questions when applying:



1. How long have you worked with Wazuh?

2. Have you installed or configured Wazuh agents before?

3. Have you monitored Wazuh alerts or dashboards before?

4. What operating systems have you monitored with Wazuh?

5. Have you worked with Wazuh vulnerability detection?

6. Have you worked with file integrity monitoring?

7. Have you reviewed logs from Windows, Linux, cloud, or Docker environments?

8. How would you report a high-risk alert to a manager?

9. What is your preferred weekly schedule?

10. What hourly rate are you requesting?



## Hiring Process



The hiring process may include:



* Resume review

* Written screening questions

* Short interview

* Technical discussion

* Wazuh task review or practical exercise

* Manager approval

* Paid trial period if selected



## Equal Opportunity Statement



AI Hub evaluates applicants based on job-related experience, technical skill, reliability, communication, schedule fit, and ability to perform the role responsibilities.

title: Tech Support & Automations Specialist (GoHighLevel + AI)
description:
About EyeFly Digital



EyeFly Digital is a marketing company that runs lead-generation and advertising for our clients. We manage a portfolio of sub-accounts and ad campaigns, each with its own AI-powered systems, tracking, and CRM connections. We're looking for a hands-on technical problem-solver to keep all of it running smoothly.



The Role



You'll be the technical backbone behind our client systems. The core of the job is supporting the AI bots built in GoHighLevel (GHL) that run across each of our sub-accounts and ad campaigns — keeping them working, troubleshooting them when something breaks, and improving them over time. You'll also own the plumbing that connects our incoming leads to our clients' CRMs.



This is a role for someone who's genuinely comfortable in the weeds of automation tools, enjoys figuring out why something stopped working, and can fix it without a lot of hand-holding.



What You'll Do



Provide ongoing tech support for GHL AI bots set up across our sub-accounts and ad campaigns

Diagnose and fix issues quickly when automations, workflows, or integrations break

Track and monitor data across campaigns, and make sure events and conversions are firing correctly

Connect our leads to clients' CRMs using tools like Jotform, Zapier, native integrations, or whatever the client's system requires



Build and maintain automations and workflows that keep lead flow reliable end-to-end

Test new setups before they go live and document how things are configured



What You Need



Strong hands-on experience with GoHighLevel (GHL) — workflows, sub-accounts, and AI bot setup



Solid experience with AI tools and a real interest in applying them to automation



Comfort with integration platforms such as Zapier and Jotform, and the ability to learn whatever CRM or tool a client uses



General technical fluency — you can troubleshoot, follow data through a system, and fix what's broken



Fluent English, written and verbal



A self-directed work style — you can take a problem and run with it



Nice to Have



Experience supporting a marketing or advertising agency environment

Familiarity with Meta/Facebook ad tracking, pixels, and conversion data

Experience working across multiple client accounts at once



How to Apply



Send your resume and a short note about your GHL and automation experience to 
 you've built or maintained AI bots in GHL before, tell us about it — that's exactly what we want to hear.



All of our employees have been with us for a year or longer. This is a great opportunity to work with a growing company with long term stability for the right teammate.

mbers.

This position is responsible for sourcing, screening, interviewing, and coordinating the hiring of skilled manufacturing professionals, technical personnel, and office staff across several business units.



The ideal candidate has experience recruiting for industrial and manufacturing environments and understands the unique challenges of finding qualified machinists, quality personnel, engineers, production staff, and administrative employees. title: Part-Time Amazon Online Arbitrage Product Sourcer
description:
We are looking for **one dependable Amazon Online Arbitrage Product Sourcer** to join our growing business.



This position will begin with a **one-week paid trial** and continue as a part-time role for the right candidate. A sourcer who consistently provides high-quality, purchasable leads may eventually be offered a **full-time position with increased compensation and additional responsibilities**.



Position Details



* Part-time: approximately **20 hours per week**

* Starting pay: **$4–$6 USD per hour**, based on experience

* One-week paid trial period

* Opportunity for performance bonuses and future pay increases

* Potential promotion to a full-time position based on performance and business growth

* Access to **SellerAmp SAS, Keepa, and Stealth Seller will be provided**



Responsibilities



* Find approximately **5–10 qualified, in-stock leads per working day**

* Use **Stealth Seller** and other storefront-stalking methods to identify potential products

* Research and analyze products using Keepa and SellerAmp SAS

* Review sales history, Buy Box history, sales rank, offer count, price stability, ROI, profit margin, and competition

* Confirm that leads meet our sourcing requirements before submitting them

* Provide accurate Amazon and supplier links

* Maintain an organized lead-tracking spreadsheet

* Follow company procedures and communicate consistently



Required Experience



Applicants should have:



* Previous Amazon Online Arbitrage sourcing experience

* Experience using **Stealth Seller for storefront stalking**

* Working knowledge of **Keepa charts**

* Experience using **SellerAmp SAS**

* Understanding of ROI, profit margin, sales rank, Buy Box history, offer counts, competition, and estimated sales

* Familiarity with manual sourcing, reverse sourcing, and storefront stalking

* Strong attention to detail

* Reliable internet and computer access

* Ability to work independently without constant supervision



You do not need to be an expert in every sourcing method, but you must already understand the basics of Amazon Online Arbitrage and be comfortable analyzing product data.



Training on our specific sourcing criteria and procedures will be provided. However, this is not an entry-level position for someone who has never used Amazon sourcing software.



Lead Requirements



Submitted leads should generally meet the following criteria:



* Product is currently in stock

* Minimum **30% ROI**

* Acceptable profit margin

* Consistent sales history

* Stable or reasonably low sales rank

* Stable Buy Box and pricing history

* Low likelihood of the selling price falling below the break-even price

* Manageable seller competition

* No obvious intellectual-property, hazmat, melting, expiration, variation, or eligibility concerns

* Pass all additional company sourcing requirements



Quality is more important than simply submitting a large number of leads. We expect the majority of submitted leads to be properly researched and potentially purchasable.



## Growth Opportunity



This is initially a part-time position. However, a candidate who consistently demonstrates reliability, accuracy, strong communication, and an ability to find profitable leads may receive:



* Increased hourly compensation

* Performance bonuses

* Additional weekly hours

* A future full-time position



Confidentiality



All leads must be researched specifically for our company. Leads may not be copied from paid lead lists, reused from previous clients, or shared with other Amazon businesses.



Applicants currently working for another Amazon seller must disclose that information in their application.



Access to company software and sourcing information must remain confidential and may only be used for authorized company work.



How to Apply



Use the name of your **favorite fruit as the title of your application** to confirm that you read the complete posting.



Please answer the following questions:



1. Have you previously worked as an Amazon Online Arbitrage sourcer?

2. How long have you been sourcing Amazon products?

3. Describe your experience using Stealth Seller for storefront stalking.

4. Explain how you use Keepa to evaluate whether a product is a good lead.

5. Describe your experience using SellerAmp SAS.

6. Which sourcing methods have you used?

7. Are you currently working for another Amazon seller or sourcing client?

8. How many hours per week are you available?

9. What hourly rate are you requesting?

10. Why should we choose you for this position?

11. What is your favorite sport, and why?



## Optional Expedited Application



Applicants who would like their application reviewed sooner may provide **three product leads researched on the same day they apply**.



For each lead, include:



* Amazon US link

* Supplier link

* Supplier cost

* Current Amazon selling price

* Estimated profit

* ROI

* Current sales rank

* Estimated monthly sales

* Number of FBA sellers

* Brief explanation of the Keepa chart

* Explanation of why the product is a strong lead



Thank you for applying. We are looking for someone dependable, accurate, honest, and interested in growing with our company over the long term.

title: Freelance Social Media Content Creator (AI-Driven)
description:
Apparel Brand is looking for a freelance content creator to independently produce and post social media content across TikTok, Instagram, X 
), and YouTube.



This is a fully self-directed role. You'll be using AI tools to generate content from scratch using our product imagery and brand guidelines  no raw footage, scripts, or pre-made material will be supplied. Our involvement is limited to reviewing content for brand fit before or after it goes live.



This is a freelance/contractor position (self-employed, invoice-based). It is not an employed role — no fixed hours, you manage your own schedule.



WHAT THE JOB INVOLVES:



-Must have good editing skills



-Producing 3-4 pieces of content per platform per day across TikTok, Instagram, X, and YouTube — roughly 12-16 total pieces daily.



-X/Twitter content can lean more text-led (brand philosophy statements, product callouts, short-form thoughts), which is faster to produce at volume. TikTok, Instagram, and YouTube should remain primarily visual/video content, built using AI image and video generation. where possible



-The core purpose of all content is communicating LGK's brand philosophy and identity consistently — not just posting for the sake of activity.



-Generating all visual content using AI tools , AI-assisted product and lifestyle imagery, AI video generation, and motion graphics from stills , since no physical shoots or supplied footage will be provided.



-Sourcing your own creative direction day to day from our brand guidelines and product images, without ongoing creative briefs from us.



-Scheduling and posting content directly via a scheduling tool (no shared account passwords).

Producing weekend content in advance during the week so posting continues 7 days a week.



-Keeping all content strictly product- and brand-focused  no personal/talking-head content, no third-party voices, no creator- or community-style messaging.



WHAT WE PROVIDE:



-Product photography and brand/style guidelines.

-A brand philosophy reference document (tone, key themes, language to use).

-Scheduling tool access to post on our behalf.

-Feedback on content for brand alignment only.



WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR:



-Strong, demonstrable experience using AI content tools (image generation, AI video, motion graphics) — please include examples or a portfolio.



-Experience with product-led and brand-led social content specifically.



-Strong written voice for text-led platforms like X.



-Ability to independently generate high daily content volume without ongoing direction.

Reliable, consistent self-management.



TO APPLY: Please share examples of AI-generated or AI-assisted content you've created, ideally product- or brand-focused, along with your usual turnaround time and the tools you work with.

title: Doodle / Whiteboard Explainer Video Editor (Faceless YouTube)
description:
We run a faceless YouTube channel explaining how businesses and money work, in a simple hand-drawn doodle style — a rough stick-figure host, sketched arrows/charts/objects that pop onto a white screen one at a time, timed to a voiceover. Think clean, fast, witty "doodle explainer." NOT polished corporate motion graphics, and NOT a static slideshow.



We provide finished scripts and professional voiceovers. We need a reliable editor to turn each script + VO into a finished 11–14 minute video.



What you'll do

- Sketch/assemble simple doodle elements (a consistent stick-figure host + props, arrows, objects) in our style.

- Time them to "draw on / pop in" exactly on the voiceover — dynamic pacing (fast 1–2s for lists, slower 3–5s for key points), nothing static.

- Drop in clean charts (we generate many via AI tools) and screenshots (headlines, tweets), framed lightly in the doodle style.

- Add on-screen text, burned-in captions, royalty-free music and subtle SFX.

- Deliver the longform + a few short vertical cut-downs (Shorts) from the same assets.



You must have

- Experience with doodle / whiteboard / explainer-style editing (the hand-drawn "draw-on" look).

- Strong sense of timing — syncing visuals tightly to a voiceover, keeping it dynamic.

- A portfolio showing explainer/doodle/whiteboard work.

- Ability to keep a consistent character and style across a long video.

- Use only licensed/royalty-free music and assets (no copyrighted clips/music).

- Reliable deadlines, clear written English.



Nice to have (NOT required)

- Integrating short real video clips (interviews, b-roll) — optional, we mostly don't use these.

- Finance/business or data-visualization editing.

- Your own licensed music/SFX library.



Hours & pay

- Per-video to start, growing into steady weekly work as we scale (we publish frequently).

- Pay: [SET RATE — see internal note].



Paid test

- Shortlisted editors are paid to produce one short test segment from our script + VO, so we can see your style, timing, and consistency before committing.



How to apply (skip a step and we delete it)

1. Start your message with the word MARGIN, so we know you read the full post.

2. Send your portfolio — specifically doodle / whiteboard / explainer samples.

3. Tell us your main tools.

4. Tell us your turnaround and your rate for one finished ~12-minute video.



We reply to everyone who follows these 4 steps.

Social Media & Video Content

title: LinkedIn Warm Outreach Specialist
description:
About TPRM Consulting Ltd

TPRM Consulting Ltd is a specialist consultancy based in the United Kingdom, focused exclusively on Third-Party Risk Management (TPRM). We help banking & financial services organizations, regulated businesses, and enterprise clients across Europe and the UK build, mature, and operate their vendor risk and third-party governance functions. Our service model is hands-on and embedded: we step in where clients need experienced practitioners, not headcount.

We are a small, high-performing remote team. You will be joining a growing operation that uses smart data and technology to identify and engage prospective clients at exactly the right 
nt in their TPRM journey.



The Role

• Job Title: LinkedIn Warm Outreach Specialist

• Employment Type: Full-Time (40 hours per week)

• Location: Remote – Philippines-based

• Salary: PHP 15,000 – PHP 20,000 per month (depending on experience and demonstrated expertise)

• Reporting To: Day-to-day management by Trin (Digital Marketing & Growth Specialist, Philippines); overall accountability to Founder & CEO at TPRM Consulting Ltd management

• Works Closely With: Trin (Data Research and Targeting), Darryl (Senior Client Pipeline Lead)

• Impact: You will be the first touchpoint with high-value prospects and will help move strong leads into productive conversations.

• Learning & Domain Exposure: This role gives you exposure to Third-Party Risk Management, Banking & Financial Services, Regulatory themes, and proprietary data sources such as TheirStack.



Where You Fit in the Team

TPRM Consulting Ltd operates a four-stage outreach pipeline to generate new business:

1. Trin analyses hiring signal data from TheirStack and LinkedIn to identify and prioritise companies that are building or expanding their TPRM function and hands you a weekly curated target list with a recommended content angle per company.

2. You take that list, find the right 2–3 contacts per company on LinkedIn Sales Navigator, and begin a warm, relationship-first outreach sequence: connecting, sharing relevant content, and nurturing conversations until they are ready for a call.

3. Darryl takes the calls you book, qualifies them, and filters genuine commercial opportunities from tyre-kickers before passing them to the founding partner.

4. Founder leads commercials, contract negotiation, and conversion.



Your role is Stage 2. You are the human face of TPRM Consulting on LinkedIn. You are not doing cold sales. You are building genuine, informed connections with professionals who are already working on the exact problems TPRM Consulting solves.



 

Key Responsibilities

LinkedIn Outreach and Relationship Building

• Receive and review Trin's weekly target company list (typically 15-20 companies per week, drawn from TheirStack hiring signal data)

• Use LinkedIn Sales Navigator to identify 2–3 relevant contacts per target company: typically VP/Head of Risk, CISO, Chief Risk Officer, Procurement Director, or the hiring manager for the relevant TPRM role

• Send personalized, role-specific connection requests - not generic, not templated, always grounded in why the connection makes sense based on what the company is hiring for

• After a connection is accepted, send a warm, non-pitching thank-you message to acknowledge the connection: no selling at this stage

• Follow target companies and engage authentically with their posts (comments, reactions) to increase visibility before and during outreach



Creativity: The individual can personalize connection requests and engagement approaches within our guidelines, rather than simply following rigid templates. These can be sent to the Director for review and approval when needed.



Content Sharing and Value Delivery

• Share relevant TPRM content assets (LinkedIn posts, newsletter editions, podcast clips, or Proof of Value documents) as directed by Trin's weekly brief - matching the asset to the contact's hiring area (e.g., DORA/ICT resilience content to DORA-hiring companies, vendor governance content to procurement-focused companies)

• Space content touches appropriately - do not flood a new connection; the goal is to appear as a helpful, knowledgeable peer, not a salesperson

• Engage with replies, questions, and comments in a natural, conversational tone that reflects TPRM Consulting's positioning as a trusted expert



Proof of Value and Call Booking

• Once a contact shows genuine engagement (replies, asks questions, engages with content, or expresses interest), introduce the Proof of Value (PoV) opportunity - a short, low-commitment engagement that demonstrates TPRM Consulting's capabilities

• When the contact is warm and receptive, suggest a short exploratory call and book it directly into Darryl's calendar using the approved scheduling tool 

• Only book calls that represent a realistic commercial opportunity - do not fill Darryl's calendar with exploratory connections that have not shown sufficient intent



CRM and Tracker Management

• Maintain the outreach tracker (Excel/HubSpot) with up-to-date status for every contact: connected, message sent, content shared, reply received, PoV offered, call booked, or not proceeding

• Work with Trin to move contacts to HubSpot only once they become warm or high-priority - do not bulk upload the full database

• Provide a weekly status update to Trin every Friday covering: new connections made, responses received, content shared, calls booked, and any objections or notable feedback from contacts - this feedback directly informs the following week's targeting and messaging



Coordination with Trin

• Attend a short weekly sync with Trin (Monday or as agreed) to review the new target list, understand the recommended content angles, and raise any questions about the week's outreach

• Provide Trin with honest, timely feedback on what is resonating and what is not - this is how the team improves together

• Flag any company or contact that appears especially high-priority or shows strong buying signals so Trin can elevate their priority tier

 

What You Are NOT Expected to Do

• Hard sell, pitch, or send unsolicited sales decks to new connections

• Reach out to companies not on the approved TheirStack-sourced target list without prior alignment

• Make any commercial promises or discuss pricing

• Conduct the exploratory calls yourself - that is Darryl's responsibility. You will be asked to join the calls where needed

• Create new content - all content assets are provided by the team; you select and share from the existing library

 

What You Need to Bring

Essential Experience

• Minimum 2 years of hands-on B2B LinkedIn outreach experience, with a demonstrable track record of generating warm, qualified conversations that led to booked meetings or commercial outcomes

• Proven proficiency with LinkedIn Sales Navigator - you must be able to run company-level searches, filter contacts by title/seniority/activity, and build targeted lead lists from an account list

• Experience working within a structured outreach pipeline - you understand your role is one link in a chain and that quality and handoff discipline matter as much as volume

• Strong written English skills - your messages represent a professional UK-based consultancy. Spelling, grammar, tone, and professionalism matter enormously. Your outreach will be reviewed regularly

• Experience tracking outreach in CRM tools or spreadsheet trackers - HubSpot experience is preferred; Excel/Google Sheets proficiency is required



Strongly Preferred Experience

• Previous work supporting a B2B professional services, consulting, compliance, or financial services business in a LinkedIn outreach or business development support role

• Familiarity with concepts such as vendor risk, third-party risk, compliance, regulatory frameworks (e.g., DORA, EBA guidelines), or financial services governance - you do not need to be a TPRM expert, but you need to be able to hold a credible LinkedIn conversation in this space

• Experience working with intent data or hiring signal tools (e.g., TheirStack, Apollo, ZoomInfo, Lusha) to prioritize outreach

• Prior experience coordinating with a remote tea
mber as a peer or working under a remote manager in a Philippines-based setup



Personal Qualities

• Patient and relationship-oriented - you understand that warm outreach is a long game and resist the urge to push for a call before the relationship is ready

• Organised and self-managing - you maintain your tracker without being prompted, hit your weekly targets, and flag blockers early

• Curious and coachable - TPRM Consulting's outreach approach will evolve; you must be willing to test, receive feedback, and adjust

• Discreet - you will have access to prospect lists, business development data, and commercially sensitive company information. This must remain strictly confidential

 

Demonstrating Your Suitability

When applying, please provide:

1. A brief written summary (300–500 words) describing a specific B2B LinkedIn outreach campaign you ran or contributed to - what industry it targeted, what your role was, what the sequence looked like, and what results it produced (connections made, replies received, meetings booked)

2. 2–3 sample LinkedIn connection request messages you have previously used or would use for the following scenario: A Head of Procurement at a European bank has just posted a role for a Third-Party Risk Analyst. Write a personalised connection request from TPRM Consulting.

3. A screenshot or description of the CRM or tracking tool you used in your most recent outreach role, showing how you managed contact status and follow-up cadence

4. Any relevant LinkedIn profile URL so we can review your professional presence - note that your personal LinkedIn profile quality is itself evidence of your ability to represent a professional brand on the platform

 

Working Arrangements

Item Detail

Hours Full-time, 40 hours per week

Schedule Monday to Friday; core working hours (BST/GMT) for at least part of the day for team syncs

Location Fully remote; must have a reliable internet connection and a professional work environment

Day-to-day manager Trin (Digital Marketing & Growth Specialist, Philippines)

Salary PHP 15,000 – PHP 20,000 per month depending on experience. 

Payment Processed monthly by TPRM Consulting Ltd

Tools provided LinkedIn Sales Navigator access, HubSpot CRM access, TheirStack data exports via Trin, content library access, Calendly

Probationary period First 30 days are a paid evaluation period; performance against agreed weekly KPIs will determine continuation



Success Criteria’s in the role 

Performance in this role will be measured against the following weekly and monthly targets. These are indicative benchmarks for a steady-state week and will be calibrated during the first 30 days based on batch size and market response rates.

KPI Target (Steady State)

Connection requests sent per week X number (aligned to Trin's weekly batch)

Connection acceptance rate 45 - 60%

Content shares per accepted connection 1 - 2 within the first 10 days of connection

Reply/engagement rate (post-connection) 100% (this is extremely important)

Calls booked per week (peak, steady state) 2 - 4 qualified calls into Darryl's calendar

Tracker updated Every Friday before close of day

Weekly feedback note to Trin Weekly (day to be d
 later)



 

Salary Context

The PHP 15,000–PHP 20,000 per month salary range reflects a full-time, specialist role requiring demonstrated B2B LinkedIn outreach experience and strong written English. This is above the Philippine national minimum wage and is competitive for remote specialist roles on platforms such as OnlineJobs.ph for this level of responsibility. 



Strong performance may lead to performance-based bonuses or increased responsibility in the outreach/client pipeline. Furthermore, strong performers could potentially grow into broader business development or client engagement roles over time.



Performance-based increments will be considered following the probationary period and at each annual review.

 

How to Apply

Submit your application to 
 with the subject line:

"LinkedIn Warm Outreach Specialist – [Your Full Name]"

Your application must include:

1. Your CV (PDF preferred)

2. Your written campaign summary (see Demonstrating Your Suitability above)

3. Your 2–3 sample LinkedIn connection request messages

4. Your LinkedIn profile URL



Applications without all four components will not be considered. We review applications on a rolling basis and will contact shortlisted candidates within 5 business days.



---



TPRM Consulting Ltd is an equal opportunity employer. We are committed to building a diverse, high-performing remote team.

title: Graphic Designer
description:
ABOUT SCRIVEINER LONDON

Scriveiner is an award-winning British luxury brand specialising in writing instruments and premium accessories.

Founded in 2019, our products are used by millions of customers worldwide, available via major online marketplaces and from more than 1,000 retail stores around the globe. Our mission is simple: to create beautiful, high-quality products that people love to use every day.

The company has grown rapidly and has been recognised with numerous awards, including the King’s Award for Enterprise, The Sunday Times 100, the Great British Entrepreneur Awards, and multiple international design awards.

Scriveiner is the flagship brand of Infinity Brands, a founder-led business focused on building premium consumer brands with global reach. We are high-growth, entrepreneurial and hands-on, and we are focused on delivering exceptional products and customer experiences.







THE OPPORTUNITY

At Scriveiner, design is not decoration. It is the product. From the curve of a pen to the layout of a product listing, every visual decision is an expression of what this brand stands for. Our customers have awarded us five product design awards. Our peers have recognised us with the King’s Award for Enterprise. The bar is not aspirational. It is already set.

We are now hiring a Graphic Designer to own the visual output of the business: everything from Amazon A+ content and Shopify imagery to packaging, print materials, and retail partner assets. This is a broad, hands-on role with real creative ownership, not a production queue role where someone else makes the decisions and you execute.

Scriveiner operates and sells globally, and as the brand expands into new markets and product categories, the volume and variety of design work will grow with it. If you want to build a genuine body of work at a brand people notice, this is where to do it.







WHAT YOU WILL OWN

Own the visual quality of every digital and physical asset Scriveiner ships: product listing images, A+ content, social graphics, packaging, print materials, and retail partner assets.

Design and maintain product listing imagery for Shopify and Amazon, ensuring all assets meet platform specifications, convert effectively, and are unmistakably on-brand.

Create Amazon A+ content modules including enhanced brand sections, comparison charts, and lifestyle image layouts that drive both conversion and brand perception.

Produce and adapt assets for retail partners, interpreting co-branding briefs and working within third-party templates without compromising brand standards.

Own packaging artwork from concept to print-ready files, coordinating with suppliers and production teams to ensure accurate, on-time delivery.

Design product manuals, inserts, and printed materials to the same standard as the product itself: clear, precise, and on-brand.

Build and maintain a library of reusable social templates across Instagram,
, LinkedIn, and YouTube to enable faster, more consistent content production.

Perform light retouching on product photography and provide simple video editing support as required.

Maintain an organised, versioned asset library so all final files are accessible and correctly named.







WHO YOU ARE

Essential — you must have this

A strong portfolio demonstrating ecommerce and product-focused design work. Amazon, Shopify, or D2C experience is expected.

Proficiency in Adobe Creative Suite (Illustrator, Photoshop, InDesign) and Figma.

A precise eye for detail and a genuine intolerance for off-brand, low-quality output.

Ability to manage multiple briefs simultaneously, prioritise effectively, and hit deadlines without being chased.

Experience designing for both digital screens and print or physical production, with an understanding of file preparation and production specs.

Commercial awareness: you understand how design influences conversion and make decisions with that in mind, not just aesthetics.

AI-literate and comfortable using tools to work more efficiently without compromising craft.



Desirable — it would strengthen your application if you have

Experience within a premium, lifestyle, gifting, or consumer goods brand where brand standards are non-negotiable.

Familiarity with Amazon A+ content and product listing image best practices.

Basic photo retouching and video editing skills using Adobe Lightroom, Premiere, or similar.

Exposure to packaging design and working directly with print suppliers or production teams.

Experience producing retail partner assets and adapting brand materials to third-party templates.







WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE

In this role, you will be successful when:

Every product listing image and A+ module is visually compelling, accurate, and consistent with brand standards.

Social and thumbnail assets are produced on time and require minimal revision.

Packaging and manual artwork is delivered print-ready, with zero production errors.

Retail partner asset requests are turned around quickly and to brief.

The creative output of the business looks unmistakably like Scriveiner, everywhere.







KEY WORKING RELATIONSHIPS

Head of Marketing: your primary brief-giver. You translate their direction into finished visual assets and raise blockers early.

Marketing & Ecommerce team: collaborate on asset requirements for campaigns, product launches, and retailer activations.

Retail partners: receive and interpret co-branding briefs and partner asset requirements.

External suppliers and print partners: manage file handover, proofing, and production sign-off.
