title: CREATING STRATEGIST - DTC ECOM UP TO 5K USD/MO
description:
Hiring DTC - ECOM CREATIVE STRATEGIST

Remote | Full-Time | Meta Ads Focus | Restricted Categories



About Growing Pains Marketing



Growing Pains Marketing is a performance marketing agency focused on scaling DTC eCommerce brands through paid social, creative strategy, and direct response advertising.



We specialize in Meta ads and work with brands in competitive and often restricted categories, including wellness, supplements, CBD-adjacent products, telemedicine, research compounds, and other markets where strong creative strategy, compliance awareness, and fast execution matter.



We are looking for a DTC eCommerce Creative Strategist who understands Meta ads inside and out, can turn research into strong creative briefs, and can help launch, monitor, and improve ad creative across multiple client accounts.



This is not just a “make pretty ads” role.



We need someone who can think strategically, understand customer psychology, study competitors, identify winning angles, write strong briefs, collaborate with designers/editors/UGC creators, and help us consistently produce ads that drive purchases.



Role Overview



As our Creative Strategist, you will be responsible for researching markets, developing creative angles, writing briefs, coordinating creative production, uploading/launching ads in Meta, and monitoring performance to identify what is working.



You should be comfortable working across multiple DTC eCommerce accounts and moving quickly without sacrificing strategy or quality.



You will work closely with media buyers, designers, video editors, UGC creators, and leadership to ensure each account has a strong pipeline of new creative.



Key Responsibilities:

Creative Strategy



Develop creative strategies for DTC eCommerce brands running Meta ads.



Research customer avatars, pain points, desires, objections, competitor positioning, reviews, Reddit threads, TikTok trends, Meta Ad Library, Amazon reviews, landing pages, and customer language.



Identify new hooks, angles, offers, formats, and messaging opportunities.



Create clear creative testing plans based on performance data and market research.



Understand direct response principles, buyer psychology, and how to structure ads that convert.



Creative Briefs



Write detailed creative briefs for designers, video editors, and UGC creators.



Include hooks, concepts, scripts, visual direction, claims/compliance notes, CTA, product positioning, and references.



Make sure briefs are specific enough that the creative team can execute without confusion.



Provide examples of winning ads, swipe files, and references when needed.



Meta Ads Execution



Upload, launch, and organize ads inside Meta Ads Manager.



Understand Meta campaign structure, ad sets, ad naming conventions, creative testing, and basic performance monitoring.



Know how to read creative performance inside Meta and identify winners, losers, and patterns.



Work with media buyers to understand what creative needs to be tested next.



Monitor active ads and help determine when creative needs to be paused, iterated, or scaled.



Creative Performance Analysis



Review ad performance by hook, angle, format, offer, product, audience, and creative type.



Identify why certain ads are working or not working.



Use performance data to inform future creative briefs.



Track winning patterns across accounts.



Help build a repeatable creative testing system.



Client-Facing Communication



Communicate clearly and professionally with clients when needed.



Present creative strategies, explain why certain angles are being tested, and provide updates on creative direction.



Strong written and spoken English is required.



You must be able to explain your thinking clearly on calls, in Slack, and in Loom videos.



Requirements



You must have experience with DTC eCommerce creative strategy.



You must understand Meta ads deeply, especially for purchase/conversion campaigns.



You must be able to upload, launch, and monitor ads inside Meta Ads Manager.



You must know how to create creative briefs that designers, editors, and UGC creators can actually execute.



You must understand customer research, competitor research, and offer positioning.



You must have excellent written and spoken English.



You must be comfortable recording Loom videos explaining your strategy.



You must be organized, fast, and able to manage multiple accounts.



You must be comfortable working with restricted or compliance-sensitive categories.



You must be available during some U.S. working hours. Between 6-9 am and 3-5 PM depending on your starting shift.



We are not hiring candidates located in North America, or citizens of North America for this role.



Nice to Have



Experience with CBD, supplements, peptides, telemedicine, health/wellness, or other restricted categories.



Experience sourcing or managing UGC creators.



Experience writing UGC scripts.



Experience with tools like Triple Whale, Motion, Foreplay, Meta Ad Library, TikTok Creative Center, Shopify, or GoHighLevel.



Experience working inside an agency.



Compensation



Base pay: $1,500–$3,000 USD per month, depending on experience and skill level.



Bonus: $100/month per account that maintains KPI on a monthly basis.



Expected account load: 10–20 accounts per month.



If you are able to handle more accounts while maintaining quality, that is a plus.



Hiring Process:



Step 1: Application



You will complete the application questions below and submit examples of your previous work.



Step 2: Level 1 Test



If your application looks strong, we will send you a short Level 1 creative strategy test.



Step 3: Interview



If your Level 1 test is strong, we will schedule an interview.



Step 4: Level 2 Test



Final candidates will complete a paid, more advanced creative strategy test before an offer is made.



Application Requirements



Please answer the questions below carefully. Generic answers will not be considered.



You must also include a Loom video under 5 minutes explaining your experience and walking us through how you think about creative strategy.



Application Questions



Experience

How many years of experience do you have with DTC eCommerce creative strategy?



What types of products or industries have you created ad strategies for?



Have you worked with Meta ads specifically? Explain your experience with campaign setup, ad launching, and performance monitoring.



Creative Strategy

Walk us through your process for going from product research to creative angles.



What makes a strong Meta ad creative for a DTC eCommerce brand?



Share 2–3 examples of creative briefs you have personally created. Include links or screenshots if possible.



Research Process

What sources do you use when researching customers, competitors, and ad angles?



How do you find customer pain points, objections, and buying triggers?



Give an example of a time your research led to a winning ad angle.



Performance Analysis

What metrics do you look at when judging whether an ad creative is working?



How do you d
 whether to kill, iterate, or scale a creative?



Give an example of an ad that failed and what you learned from it.



Communication

This is a client-facing role. How comfortable are you explaining creative strategy to clients?



You MUST include a Loom video under 5 minutes introducing yourself and explaining your creative strategy process.



Rate your spoken and written English from 1–10 and briefly explain.



Availability & Fit

What country and time zone are you located in?

Are you available to work some U.S. business hours?

What monthly compensation are you looking for in USD?



How to Apply



DO NOT MESSAGE ME ON ONLINEJOBS.PH

YOU MUST submit the following to 
 portfolio.



Examples of creative briefs you have created.



Examples of ads you helped strategize.



A Loom video under 5 minutes explaining your creative strategy process.



Answers to the application questions above.

title: Senior Designer (AI-Native) — Web, Landing Pages & Meta Ad Creative
description:
### About Impressive Click

Founded in 2008, we're a growth-focused digital marketing agency specializing in high-converting websites, landing pages, and Meta ad creative. With over 2,500 successful projects, we've helped businesses of all sizes — including Fortune 500 companies like Colgate-Palmolive, Philip Morris International, Altria Group, and Dover Corporation — maximize their online presence. We move fast, hold a high bar, and care deeply about the details that separate good work from work that actually performs.



### The Role

We're hiring one exceptional designer — an A-player who treats AI as a core part of how they work, not an afterthought. You'll own design across three areas: building websites, designing landing pages that convert, and producing static Meta ad creative that stops the scroll.



This isn't a seat-filler role. We want someone who pairs genuine craft with speed, uses AI to multiply their output without sacrificing quality, and takes full ownership of what they ship.



### What You'll Do

- Design and build websites and landing pages engineered to convert, not just look good

- Produce high-volume, high-quality static ad creative for Meta 
/Instagram)

- Use AI tools throughout your workflow to work faster and explore more directions

- Translate campaign goals and audience insights into design that performs

- Maintain brand consistency across every asset and client

- A/B test creative and landing page variations, then iterate on what wins

- Optimize for speed, mobile responsiveness, and real-world performance

- Juggle multiple projects and deliver on time without dropping quality



### What You Bring

- A portfolio that immediately makes the case — web, landing pages, and ad creative that's both beautiful and conversion-minded

- AI baked into your process (generation, ideation, iteration, production) with a clear sense of where it helps and where craft still wins

- Expert-level Figma plus Adobe Suite (Photoshop, Illustrator, InDesign)

- Strong command of typography, color, layout, and visual hierarchy

- Real understanding of conversion-focused design, marketing funnels, and CRO

- Hands-on experience designing within Meta ad formats and specs

- Fluent written and spoken English, and reliable overlap with EST hours

- The ability to manage your own workload, communicate clearly, and own outcomes



### How We Hire

Shortlisted candidates will complete a creative task so we can see how you actually think and execute. It's the fastest way for us to evaluate real work quality — and for you to show us what you've got.



### Why Join

- Be part of the early days of a growing business where your work ships and matters

- Small team, big impact, real ownership

- Remote-first with EST overlap

- Competitive pay based on experience

- Room to grow as we grow

title: Children's Book Animator
description:
Children's Book Animator Remote Role Description

Part-Time | Senior Tier GBP 450 monthly| Flexible Hours (with UK morning overlap from c. 7:00 AM BST) 



ABOUT THE BUSINESS

We are an established independent children's book publisher launching an innovative, brand-new animation strand. The business focuses on creating engaging educational and narrative content for young audiences. We are pioneering a workflow that bridges traditional publishing with cutting-edge digital media, and this hire will play a foundational role in shaping this sustainable growth area.



THE TEAM

Creative Director & Project Lead

Production & Editorial Team

New hire - this role



OVERVIEW

This is a self-directed, pioneering role designed for a senior animator comfortable building a brand-new function within an established company. The core focus is bringing an established children's science book series to life through short, high-quality animations. These deliverables will primarily populate a dedicated YouTube channel, with additional rollouts across social media shorts and phone-viewable animations triggered by in-book QR codes.



The production strategy is highly innovative, combining advanced AI animation tools with original book illustrations to keep the workflow nimble, efficient, and affordable. The animator will own the process from initial storyboarding to final render. We are seeking someone genuinely versed in AI workflows who can confidently propose their own toolset, take initiative, and map out a completely new animation pipeline.



KEY RESPONSIBILITIES



*Storyboard & Concept Development

-Translate book spreads into clear, engaging motion sequences by storyboarding scenes before production.

-Develop creative concepts for brand assets, including a short 10–15 second animated logo ident.



*Animation & AI Pipeline Production

-Produce short animations from original book illustrations using advanced, AI-assisted workflows.

-Work directly from supplied artwork, brand assets, and layered character files (such as PSDs).

-Deliver optimized content formatted for YouTube first, while ensuring assets are easily adaptable for social media and in-book QR code integration.



*Workflow Optimization & Collaboration

-Recommend, test, and operate the right tools and software for the pipeline, identifying strategic paid AI tools for company investment where they improve speed or affordability.

-Take creative direction from the project leadership team and iterate confidently based on feedback.

Work efficiently and independently to help actively shape the animation workflow as this new strand develops.



*Systems & Software

-Full flexibility is provided, as the animator will choose their own optimal tools. The company is fully open to investing in paid -AI software where a clear gain in speed, output, or affordability can be demonstrated. The core operational stack involves:



*AI Animation Tools (chosen and managed by the specialist)

-Storyboarding software (experience with tools like StoryBuild AI is a plus)

-Adobe Photoshop (working with layered PSD assets)

-3D Animation & Rendering software (for brand idents)

-Digital Platforms (YouTube, social media channels)



ROLE REQUIREMENTS

-At least 5+ years of senior-level animation experience, including strong character animation work with an intuitive feel for timing, weight, and appeal to a young audience.

-Genuinely versed in modern AI animation tools with the ability to construct an efficient, AI-assisted production pipeline.

-Comfortable and skilled at seamlessly combining AI workflows with supplied 2D illustrations and layered PSD assets.

-Proven storyboarding ability to map out sequences visually before executing production.

-3D animation capability, specifically for creating polished brand idents and introductory sequences.

-Excellent written and spoken English communication skills.

-Specialist's own computer and production software setup.



Highly Desirable

Technical proficiency in motion graphics, compositing, lighting, and rendering.

Demonstrated experience producing and optimizing video content specifically for YouTube and major social platforms.

A professional background animating children’s, family, or character-led content.

A strong showreel or portfolio demonstrating relevant stylistic depth and successful AI-assisted work.



Personal Attributes

Highly self-directed and comfortable pioneering a brand-new function independently.

Proactive and efficient, with a strong drive to establish a smooth workflow from a fast-moving, fresh brief.

Collaborative mindset, remaining highly receptive to creative direction and capable of iterating smoothly based on team feedback.

Innovative thinker, constantly looking for ways to optimize production and quality through technology.



SUCCESS INDICATORS



-The new animation strand is launched successfully, with short children's science animations produced efficiently and on schedule.

-A polished 10–15 second brand logo ident is completed to a high creative standard.

-An efficient, scalable, and affordable AI-assisted animation pipeline is established and documented.

-Delivered animation files seamlessly fit technical requirements across YouTube, social platforms, and print-linked QR codes.

-The specialist operates with high autonomy, providing clear recommendations on tools and smoothly integrating creative feedback from leadership.

title: Marketing Assistant
description:
ABOUT SCRIVEINER LONDON

Scriveiner is an award-winning British luxury brand specialising in writing instruments and premium accessories.

Founded in 2019, our products are used by millions of customers worldwide, available via major online marketplaces and from more than 1,000 retail stores around the globe. Our mission is simple: to create beautiful, high-quality products that people love to use every day.

The company has grown rapidly and has been recognised with numerous awards, including the King’s Award for Enterprise, The Sunday Times 100, the Great British Entrepreneur Awards, and multiple international design awards.

Scriveiner is the flagship brand of Infinity Brands, a founder-led business focused on building premium consumer brands with global reach. We are high-growth, entrepreneurial and hands-on, and we are focused on delivering exceptional products and customer experiences.







THE OPPORTUNITY

Scriveiner is entering its next chapter: building from a well-established, award-winning brand into a globally recognised name in accessible luxury. New markets, new product ranges, and a rapidly growing direct and retail footprint mean the business needs people who are as good at building systems as they are at running them.

The Marketing & Ecommerce Assistant is the connective tissue of our marketing and commercial operations. This is the role that keeps the engine running: ensuring the Shopify catalogue is flawless, the retailer pipeline is active and accurately tracked, and the weekly reporting tells a clear, actionable story. It is not a support role. It is an ownership role.

Scriveiner operates and sells globally, and as the brand expands into new markets, the coordination and localisation demands of this role will grow with it





WHAT YOU WILL OWN

Own the Shopify catalogue end to end: product uploads, descriptions, imagery, pricing, tagging, and collections, with a zero-tolerance standard for accuracy across all live listings in every active market.

Keep the retailer outreach tracker live and current across all regions, logging every conversation, follow-up, and next action so no pipeline relationship goes cold.

Produce the weekly ecommerce report autonomously, without prompting, delivering clean, action-oriented performance data that the business can act on immediately.

Coordinate new market and product launch asset production, managing timelines, briefing designers and translators, and ensuring all creative and localisation requirements land ahead of launch windows with zero gaps.

Draft and send trade communications to prospective and existing retail partners across all active territories, written to Scriveiner brand standards, not to a template.

Build and maintain ecommerce dashboards that give real, useful visibility into what is working and what needs attention.

Flag risks and anomalies proactively: Shopify discrepancies, performance dips, asset gaps, or retailer conversations going cold, before they become problems that need escalation.







WHO YOU ARE

Essential — you must have this

Hands-on Shopify experience: you have managed a live store and understand catalogue management, product uploads, pricing, and data accuracy in practice, not just in theory.

Organisational ability that closes loops without prompting. You track your own work, know what is outstanding, and get things finished.

Confidence with data: comfortable building dashboards, maintaining trackers, and presenting performance in a way that tells a clear story.

Strong written English, capable of drafting trade communications and brand-consistent copy that does not need a round of editing before it goes out.

Ability to manage several concurrent workstreams across different markets without losing detail in any of them.

AI-literate and comfortable using tools, whether for writing, reporting, or workflow automation, to work more efficiently.



Desirable — it would strengthen your application if you have

Experience in wholesale, retail account management, or trade marketing. You understand how retailer relationships work in practice.

Exposure to multi-market or international marketing operations, including asset localisation and translation management.

Background in a premium, lifestyle, or gifting brand where attention to presentation and brand standards is non-negotiable.

Experience using analytics platforms beyond spreadsheets: Shopify analytics, Google Analytics, or similar.







WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE

In this role, you will be successful when:

The Shopify catalogue is 100?curate at all times across every active market: every product live, correctly described, correctly priced.

The retailer outreach tracker is live and current, with no conversations going cold and every pipeline contact properly followed up.

The weekly ecommerce report is produced every week, on time, without being asked, and tells a story the business can act on.

New market asset coordination runs on schedule, with all creative and localisation requirements delivered ahead of launch windows.

Risks, whether a listing error, a performance anomaly, or a missed follow-up, are flagged before they need to be caught by someone else.







KEY WORKING RELATIONSHIPS

Head of Marketing: direct line manager. You free them from operational bottlenecks and keep every system running without escalation.

Creative / Brand team: coordinate on asset production, product imagery, and brand-consistent communications.

Ops / Warehousing: coordinate Shopify inventory alignment.

Retail partners and prospects: day-to-day trade communication and outreach administration.

Founders: occasional visibility on pipeline and reporting outputs.

description:
Lead Generation & Research Specialist

(Remote · Full-time or Part-time · Long-term)



**READ THIS BEFORE YOU APPLY**



We get a LOT of applications, and we only read the ones from people who actually read the post. So here is your tiny test (you've got this):



1. Start your application with the word **Luminate**

2. In one sentence, tell us one type of company we do NOT want as a lead. The answer is hiding somewhere in this post. ????



No code word, no answer? Straight to the "maybe next time" pile. We promise we still think you're lovely.



---



**Who We Are**



Luminate Productions is a Belgian marketing growth partner for AI-first B2B companies. We help founders who already have a live AI product win their first 1.000 paying customers through smart, AI-driven marketing systems.



We're small, fast, and a little obsessed with doing things properly. You'd be one of our first hires, working directly with the founder. If you love clean systems, sharp research, and watching your work turn into real results (not just a spreadsheet nobody opens), you're going to feel right at home here.



No corporate stiffness. No "per my last
." Just good work, good energy, and good results.



**The Role**



We're looking for a Lead Generation & Research Specialist to build and qualify our list of dream clients. You'll hunt down the right companies, check whether they actually fit our criteria, and enrich each lead with everything we need before we reach out.



This is the engine room of our sales process. Great leads in means great clients out. We need someone precise, curious, and reliable. Someone who would rather hand over 20 perfect leads than 500 random ones and a shrug.



A few practical things:



- Full-time or part-time, depending on the right person

- Long-term role with room to scale into a full lead generation role, including outreach, across Europe and eventually the world. Start with the list, grow into the whole machine.



**What You Will Do**



- Find AI-first B2B companies in Belgium and the Netherlands that match our ideal client profile

- Work inside LinkedIn Sales Navigator to build the list, mark who is a qualified lead, and move them into HubSpot or our list-building sheet

- Qualify each company against a clear scorecard we give you (team size, revenue, industry, and more, all spelled out for you)

- Check each company's financial health on companyweb.be: look at the ARR, the numbers, and whether the company is healthy or waving little red flags

- Enrich each lead: founder name, LinkedIn URL, company website,
, team size

- A lot of companies are Dutch-speaking, so now and then you'll need to translate a page or two to check whether they're a real fit (Google Translate is totally fine)

- Keep everything tidy in the spreadsheet or CRM: no duplicates, no missing fields, no chaos

- Flag the strongest-fit leads so the founder knows exactly where to aim first



**Who We Want As Leads (and Who We Really Don't)**



So you know what you're hunting for, here's our dream company:



- AI-first businesses AND IT-automation companies with room to grow beyond their borders, internationally

- Small teams (roughly 1 to 10 people), based in Belgium or the Netherlands

- Funded or with early revenue, run by a founder who isn't afraid to be visible



Want the full checklist? We've put all the exact criteria right here, so you have them from minute one:





And here's who we do NOT want (yes, this is the answer to question 2 up top, you're welcome):



- Cybersecurity companies

- Odoo-implementation companies

- Hospitality or staffing businesses

- Companies with no real product yet, or big companies that already have their own marketing team



**About You**



- Excellent written English

- Sharp research skills and the kind of attention to detail where you double-check your own work before anyone asks

- Comfortable with LinkedIn, Sales Navigator, Google Sheets, and digging up company info online

- Experience with lead generation, list building, or research for an agency is a BIG plus

- Friendly with AI tools (ChatGPT, Claude) to move faster, while still checking the facts yourself, because robots get it wrong too

- A self-starter who's reliable, organised, and communicates clearly



**What To Expect**



- A fast, friendly, no-bullshit working environment

- Direct contact with the founder and crystal-clear instructions

- A proper scorecard and process, so you're never left guessing

- Steady work and a real chance to grow with us as we sign more clients



**How To Apply**



Still here? Love that! Here's your task. Keep it short and sharp, we care about quality, not word count.



Your task:



1. Find 5 companies you think match our ideal client profile (check the criteria google doc above)

2. For each one, give us: company name, website, founder name, LinkedIn URL, and one sentence on WHY it's a good fit

3. Add ONE company that looks like a fit but actually isn't, and tell us why not (this is the fun part, and the one that tells us you really get it)



Pop your answer in a Google Sheet or simple doc and share the link.



And remember: start your message with the code word and answer the NOT-a-fit question at the top. Those are the first things we look for. ????

Executive Assistant to the Principal Designer (Ishita Lalan)



Company: Ishita Interiors

Location: Remote (US time zones preferred)

Type: Full-Time

Reports to: Ishita Lalan, Principal Designer



About Ishita Interiors



Ishita Interiors is a fast-scaling interior design studio known for bold, emotionally resonant spaces with a strong point of view. Led by Principal Designer Ishita Lalan—whose roots in architecture and Bollywood set design bring a cinematic lens—we create elevated interiors that feel unforgettable and function beautifully. This is a real studio with real velocity—multiple projects moving at once, lots of stakeholders, and constant decisions.





The Role (Read this first)



This is a high-velocity, high-ownership Executive Assistant role supporting a creative principal. Ishita is the visionary—fast, creative, and idea-rich. You are the operational anchor: structured, decisive, and relentless about follow-through.



You will be stepping into a world that can feel chaotic at times (because creative work moves fast). Your superpower is making sense of chaos—turning scattered inputs into clean priorities, clear communication, and a plan that the team can execute.



If you are naturally a high-D / driver personality (decisive, direct, action-oriented), love creating systems, and take pride in being the person who keeps everything moving—this role will feel like home.



What You’ll Do

1) Inbox + Communication Command Center (Top Priority)

Own Ishita’s inbox daily: triage, organize, label, respond, draft, escalate

Keep a tight follow-up loop so nothing drops (clients, vendors, team)

Draft crisp, professional communication that matches the brand voice: warm, confident, direct

Turn unclear requests into clear next steps by asking the right questions and closing loops



2) Calendar + Priority Management

Own scheduling and protect Ishita’s focus time

Build daily/weekly clarity: what matters now, what can wait, what needs escalation

Prepare Ishita for meetings with context, agendas, and “what decision is needed”



3) Design Project Support (Studio Ops for Creative Work)

Track project milestones, approvals, open decisions, and dependencies across multiple projects

Maintain simple project trackers: timelines, action items, who owns what, and due dates

Coordinate with clients, vendors, contractors, and internal team to keep projects moving

Capture meeting notes, decisions, and action lists—and drive follow-through to completion



4) Organization + Systems Implementation

Create repeatable systems: templates, checklists, SOPs, naming conventions, file structure

Improve how the studio runs: fewer dropped balls, less back-and-forth, faster execution

Translate Ishita’s ideas into structured plans that others can implement



5) Pressure Handling + Rapid Problem Solving

Stay calm when something changes last minute (because it will)

Anticipate risks, surface constraints early, and present options (Plan A/B/C)

Communicate issues clearly with impacts, timelines, and recommended next steps





You’ll Thrive Here If You Are

Elite communicator. Clear writing, sharp summaries, confident tone. You love closing loops.

An exceptional organizer. You create clarity quickly and keep many moving pieces synchronized.

Calm under pressure. You don’t spiral when things change—you prioritize and execute.

A driver (high-D). You take initiative, make decisions, push progress, and hate dropped balls.

A fast learner. Tools, design vocabulary, and new workflows don’t intimidate you.

Process-minded. You don’t just survive chaos—you build systems that prevent it next time.



Qualifications

- 2+ years in an Executive Assistant, Operations Assistant, Project Coordinator, Producer, or similar role supporting a senior leader

- Strong proficiency with Google Workspace (Gmail, Calendar, Drive, Docs)

title: Product Engineer
description:
You might call yourself a full-stack developer or backend engineer today. We think that role is changing fast and we're looking for someone who's already feeling it.



We're a small Dutch tech company building ComChamp - the central nervous system for organisations. Today it's a CRM and Customer Journey Orchestration platform. Our clients are energy and telecom companies in the Netherlands who use it to run everything from lead intake to proposals to service delivery, without stitching five tools together.



Where it's going: an Agentic Communication Hub, where AI agents handle routine interactions, hand off to humans for complex ones, and operate within the same journeys and audit trails. Same workflow, executed by a person or an AI. That's what we're building toward.



Our team is 8 people. Our codebase is 25+ TypeScript microservices. And we're growing.





**What this role actually is**

We don't need someone to write code line by line. AI does that now and we use it extensively. What we need is someone who can think clearly about what to build, direct AI to build it, and know when it's getting it wrong.



That means:

- You understand how systems connect - databases, APIs, queues, state management - not at the syntax level, but at the "why is this architected this way" level

- You can look at an AI-generated solution and smell when something is off

- You can break a messy business problem into clean, executable steps

- You can explain a complex idea simply - to a teammate, to a client, to an AI



This is a product role as much as an engineering role. You'll think about what users need, how workflows should behave, and where the system should be smarter. Then you'll make it happen with AI as your primary tool.



**What you bring**

Must-haves: 

- Strong understanding of backend systems (we use NestJS, Prisma, PostgreSQL, but we care more about depth than specific frameworks) 

- Experience working with AI coding tools Cursor, Claude, Copilot, or similar 

- Clear written and spoken English - this is non-negotiable, it's how we work 

- The ability to think at the product level, not just the ticket level 



Great to have: 

- Experience with workflow engines, state machines, or process automation 

- Familiarity with Docker, Kubernetes, RabbitMQ, Redis, or GCP 

- Interest in AI agents and autonomous systems - not as hype, but as real engineering problems 



**What we offer**

- Salary in line with your capabilities paid reliably, every time 

- Long-term contract, as we're not looking for a quick project, we're building a team 

- Real ownership and influence on what we build and how 

- We bet heavily on AI-driven development and constantly experiment with the newest capabilities, always tied to real deliverables. 

- Small team, big ambitions where your work directly shapes the product 

- Work with people who think differently about what software teams will look like 



**How to apply**

Don't just send a CV. Write us a short message (a few paragraphs is fine) that answers two things: 

- What's something complex that you understand really well? Could be technical, could be anything. Explain it to us like we know nothing about it.

- Why does this role interest you? Not a generic answer, but what specifically about how we described this made you want to respond? 



We read every application. The way you write your response tells us more than your resume. 



--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------



We're building infrastructure for a world where communication IS operation, where small organizations can operate at enterprise scale, and where autonomous agents work alongside humans. If solving these problems excites you, we'd love to hear from you.

title: Digital Marketing & LinkedIn Growth Specialist (Remote – Philippines)
description:
Job Title

Digital Marketing & LinkedIn Growth Specialist (Remote – Philippines)

________________________________________

About TPRM Consulting Ltd

TPRM Consulting Ltd is a UK-based boutique consultancy focused on Third-Party Risk Management (TPRM), vendor due diligence, and AI governance for banks and financial services companies across the UK and Europe. We help clients meet regulations such as DORA, ISO 27001, ISO 42001, and other operational resilience requirements.

We are a small, founder-led team with ambitious growth plans for 2026. This role is a chance to work closely with the Managing Director and get hands-on exposure to B2B marketing, LinkedIn growth, and (later) sales development in a highly specialized niche.

This is a long-term, full-time, work-from-home role for candidates based in the Philippines.

________________________________________

Role Overview

We are looking for a Digital Marketing & LinkedIn Growth Specialist to help grow our company’s presence on LinkedIn, build awareness with senior decision-makers in European banks, and support our content and newsletter efforts.

In the first 3–6 months, the role will primarily focus on:

• Growing our LinkedIn presence (company page + founder profile)

• Researching target accounts and decision-makers

• Creating and scheduling content (posts, simple visuals, newsletters)

• Building and maintaining clean data in our CRM

Over time (once you are comfortable and trained), the role will grow into:

• Warm LinkedIn outreach and relationship-building

• Booking introductory calls into the Managing Director’s calendar

• Light sales development work (no hard selling at the beginning)

This is NOT a hardcore cold-calling job from day one. It is a phased role that starts with content, research, and LinkedIn growth, and then gradually progresses into outreach and appointment setting once you are ready.

________________________________________

Key Responsibilities (Phase 1: First 3–6 Months)

1. LinkedIn & Content (Approx. 50%)

2. Manage and grow the TPRM Consulting 
pany page

3. Help manage the Managing Director’s personal LinkedIn profile:

• Draft posts about TPRM, vendor risk, AI governance, DORA, ISO 42001, etc.

• Repurpose insights, articles, and regulatory updates into LinkedIn posts

4. Schedule and publish 3–5 posts per week (company + MD profile combined)

5. Monitor post-performance (impressions, reactions, comments, followers) and suggest improvements

Research & Target Account Building (Approx. 30%) – training will be provided

1. Research UK and European banks and financial institutions that fit our Ideal Customer Profile (ICP)

2. Identify key decision-makers on LinkedIn (e.g., CRO, VP/Head of Compliance, Head of Third-Party Risk, CISO)

3. Build and maintain structured target lists in our CRM (company, contact, role, LinkedIn URL, notes)

4. Track relevant regulatory or industry news for these target accounts (e.g., DORA, operational resilience updates)

Newsletter & Light Marketing Support (Approx. 20%)

1. Help draft a short monthly or bi-weekly
 newsletter (with guidance from the Managing Director)

2. Collect and organize links, articles, and TPRM-related news into simple summaries

3. Coordinate basic formatting and sending of newsletters using simple tools (e.g., HubSpot, MailerLite, or similar)

4. Support basic website/content updates as needed (no coding required)

________________________________________

Future Responsibilities (Phase 2–3, After Training)

As you grow and become more comfortable, you will gradually move into:

1. Sending warm LinkedIn messages to people who have:

• Engaged with our content

• Accepted connection requests

• Subscribed to our newsletter

2. Suggesting and booking introductory calls between interested prospects and the Managing Director

3. Light
 outreach to warm leads (no aggressive selling)

4. Eventually (if you are suitable), support:

• Simple BANT-style qualification (Budget, Authority, Need, Timeline)

• Coordination and follow-up after introductory calls

You will NOT be thrown into aggressive cold calling. Any move into outbound sales development will be structured, trained, and gradual.

________________________________________

Required Skills & Experience

Must-Haves (we will heavily test these):

1. Excellent written English (clear, professional, and concise)

2. Strong interest in LinkedIn as a professional platform

3. Comfortable researching companies and people online (Google, LinkedIn, company sites)

4. Basic familiarity with social media (posting, scheduling, engagement)

5. High attention to detail and ability to work independently

6. Reliable internet connection and your own laptop/PC suitable for daily remote work

7. Willing to work at least 4 hours overlapping with UK time (e.g., 3pm–7pm or 4pm–8pm Manila time), with flexibility to adjust over time

Nice-to-Haves (advantage, but not required):

1. Experience managing a LinkedIn page or personal brand for a previous employer or client

2. Experience in digital marketing, social media management, content writing, or virtual assistance

3. Familiarity with any CRM (HubSpot, Pipedrive, Salesforce, etc.)

4. Interest in cybersecurity, risk management, or financial services

5. Experience working with foreign (UK, EU, US, AU) clients

If you don’t meet every “nice-to-have” but you are strong in written English, research, and LinkedIn, you are encouraged to apply.

________________________________________

Personality & Working Style

We are looking for someone who is:

1. Curious and willing to learn about new topics (TPRM, AI governance, regulations)

2. Proactive and able to suggest ideas (e.g., post topics, ways to improve engagement)

3. Comfortable receiving feedback and iterating on work

4. Consistent and reliable — shows up on time and meets deadlines

5. Discreet and trustworthy with sensitive information

________________________________________

Working Hours & Time Zone

1. Full-time: 40 hours per week

2. Schedule (initially): Flexible during the day in the Philippines, with at least 4 hours overlap with UK business hours (e.g., 3pm–7pm or 4pm–8pm Manila time)

3. As the role evolves into more outreach and calendar booking, some additional overlap with UK time will be needed (we will discuss and agree together)

________________________________________

Compensation & Benefits

1. Monthly Salary Range:

• PHP 18,000 – PHP 25,000 (depending on experience and skills)

2. Type: Full-time, long-term remote role (starting as contractor, with the intention to move to a more formal employment structure after a successful initial period)

3. Opportunities for salary review and role expansion after 6 months based on performance

4. Potential future promotion into a Junior SDR / Sales Development position as you grow

We are transparent about the range so both sides can quickly see if there is a match.

________________________________________

Growth & Career Path

This role is ideal if you:

1. Want to move from general digital marketing / social media into a niche B2B/LinkedIn-heavy role

2. Want to learn how B2B consulting firms sell into banks and financial institutions

3. Are open to evolving into a Sales Development Representative (SDR) over time, if it fits

Potential progression paths:

1. Digital Marketing & LinkedIn Lead (owning content and brand presence)

2. Junior SDR / Lead Generation Specialist (more outreach and meeting booking)

3. Over the long term, possibly Senior SDR or Marketing & Growth Lead, depending on your performance and company growth

________________________________________

Tools You’ll Use 

You do not need to be an expert in these on Day 1, but you should be comfortable learning:

1. LinkedIn (company & personal profiles, search, posting)

2. Simple design tools (Canva or similar) for basic visuals (Training Provided)

3. Basic CRM (likely HubSpot or Pipedrive - Training Provided)

4. Simple newsletter/email tools (HubSpot, MailerLite, or similar)

5. Google Workspace (Docs, Sheets, Slides) or Microsoft Office

________________________________________

How to Apply

Please read this carefully and follow all steps. This is part of how we assess attention to detail.

To apply:

1. Send your CV/Resume (PDF preferred).

2. In your message, include:

• A short introduction (3–5 sentences) about your background

• Why this role interests you and why you think you’re a good fit

• Your current location in the Philippines

• Your expected monthly salary in PHP

3. Complete this short writing task:

• Write a sample LinkedIn post (180–300 words) that you would publish from our Managing Director’s profile on the topic:

“Why Third-Party Risk Management matters for European banks in 2026.”

• The tone should be professional but conversational, suitable for LinkedIn.

4. At the very end of your message, include the word: “RESILIENCE” (in all caps).

• This is to confirm you have read the job post fully and can follow instructions.

Applications that do not follow the instructions above may not be considered.

________________________________________

What Happens After You Apply

• Shortlisted candidates will be invited to:

• A 30-minute video interview (English, via Zoom or Google Meet)

• A paid test task (e.g., researching target companies and drafting a short content plan) to see how you work

• Final candidates will have a brief call with the Managing Director before an offer is made.

title: High converting social media ads
description:
OVERVIEW:



At Blue Zone Pets, we believe the single biggest lever you have over your dog's health is what you put in their bowl. We're a pet nutrition brand built around one mission: their longest life, back in your hands. Our food is 80% real meat, dried below 40°C to lock in maximum nutrients, with zero fillers, zero additives — just ingredients you can actually read and trust. We're building a brand that dog owners genuinely believe in, backed by a 4.6 Trustpilot rating and a growing community of owners who've seen the difference real nutrition makes. We're still early, moving fast, and looking for people who want to build something that matters. Join us as a Graphic Designer and help us become the standard for how dogs should be fed.



KEY RESPONSIBILITIES:

1. Design high-performing creatives, static ads, and branded assets that are on-brand and built to convert — owning the visual output from concept to final file.

2. Use AI generation tools to produce raw assets, then refine them with enhancement tools (Magnific AI, Topaz, Photoshop AI) until quality is indistinguishable from a professional shoot.

3. Proactively pitch new content ideas, visual formats, and workflow improvements — you don't wait for briefs, you spot opportunities and ship.



REQUIREMENTS:

1. A sharp-eyed designer with deep command of layout, typography, colour, and composition — highly proficient in Figma (primary) and Adobe Creative Suite.

2. Skilled at AI-assisted design: you use generative tools to create base assets and enhancement tools to push them to production quality. One render is never your final output.

3. Self-managing, organised, and deadline-driven — you don't need hand-holding. You see what needs doing and do it.

4. A quick learner who adapts fast to new tools and workflows; experience with Notion for project management, WhatsApp for daily communication, and openness to tools like Gather for virtual collaboration as we scale.

5. Genuinely excited about what we're building at Blue Zone — you care about quality, you care about pets, and you want to be part of a brand that's changing how people think about dog nutrition.



WHAT YOU CAN EXPECT FROM US:

- A small, ambitious team where your work has direct impact — no layers, no bureaucracy, just ownership and 
ntum.

- A culture that rewards initiative. If you spot an opportunity and act on it, we'll notice.

- Real growth potential — we're scaling quickly, and the people who join now will shape how this company operates as it grows.

- Founders who are hands-on, transparent, and genuinely invested in your development — not just your output.



COMPENSATION:

- Part-time position. Monthly creative sprints

- Competitive rate based on experience and qualifications. Per project basis, $10 per project ? $300 p/m



APPLICATION PROCESS:

Here's how to apply:



Fill out this form ? Apply here: 
/forms/d/e/1FAIpQLSfpKsPzRTlRlBchmQGnBe44Ny5yJKk-vDUbNtUykxA_Ezm2aQ/viewform?usp=header



Only completed applications will be considered.



Once you've submitted, reply here with the subject line: "PAW"



We're looking forward to hearing from you. If you're the right fit, you'll be joining a team that's building something dogs (and their owners) actually deserve.



Best regards,

Dean

Co-founder of Blue Zone Pets

title: Detail-Obsessed Virtual Assistant for UK Speech & Language Therapy Company (Admin - Data - Research)
description:
Job Title: Detail-Obsessed Virtual Assistant for UK Speech & Language Therapy Company (Admin · Data · Research)



Type: Part-time leaning full-time — 35 hours/week

Salary: $5.00 USD/hour — approx. $760 USD / ?43,000 per month for 35 hrs/week

Schedule: Must overlap UK working hours (see below)

Start: As soon as the right person is found





About us



Unlocking Language is a London-based, award-winning speech and language therapy provider. Since 2013 we've grown to around 50 therapists working with 100+ schools and clinics, and we're on a mission to deliver 1 million hours of therapy by 2030. Behind every therapy session is a lot of careful admin — scheduling, records, invoicing, follow-ups — and we need it done accurately, because sloppy data affects real children getting real support.



The role



You'll support our wider team across three areas:





Everyday admin — inbox and calendar support, scheduling, document preparation, data entry, and chasing follow-ups so nothing slips.

Data integrity — keeping our CRM and finance records clean, accurate, de-duplicated and reconciled. This means spotting problems — mismatched numbers, duplicate clients, dates that don't add up — and flagging them, not blindly copying data across.

Research & information gathering — pulling together clear, structured findings from the web and our internal systems, and presenting them so a busy manager can make a decision in 30 seconds.





You'll touch tools like Xero (finance), Ninox (CRM/scheduling), GoHighLevel (marketing/pipeline), Lark, and Google Workspace. We'll train you on the ones you don't know — we care far more about how carefully you think than which logos are on your CV.



Who you are





Precise. You notice the typo, the duplicate, the number that's slightly off. Details bother you until they're right.

Strong written English. Clear, natural, professional. You can write a follow-up
 a UK client would happily receive.

Proactive. You flag problems and propose a fix rather than waiting to be told, or guessing and hoping.

Reliable across time zones. You're contactable and responsive during UK hours.

Trustworthy with sensitive data (we work with children and schools — discretion is essential).





Nice to have (not required): prior experience with any of Xero, Ninox, GoHighLevel, or busy multi-person calendars.



Hours & overlap



This is a UK-facing role. You must be available for a core overlap with UK daytime hours — roughly 9:00am to 4:00pm UK time most working days (that's mid-afternoon to evening Philippine time). We're flexible on the exact split as long as the overlap is real and consistent.



What we offer





Stable, long-term work with a values-driven company doing meaningful work.

A team that respects your time and gives clear instructions.

Genuine training and growth — the right person can take on more responsibility (and pay) over time.





How to apply (read carefully — this matters)

title: Amazon Seller Central VA
description:
Position Overview

We are seeking a detail-oriented and highly organized Seller Central-focused Virtual Assistant to manage and optimize Amazon outbound shipment workflows. This role requires strong operational execution inside Amazon Seller Central, with a focus on shipment creation, shipment cost tracking, logistics coordination, inventory management, and placement fee analysis. The ideal candidate is highly proficient in Excel and Google Sheets, understands Amazon shipment methods including SPD, LTL, and FTL, and can accurately analyze shipment costs to support operational and financial decision-making.



Seller Central Shipment Management

This role is responsible for creating and managing Amazon shipment plans based on client-provided SKU and quantity requests. The successful candidate will coordinate shipments using SPD, LTL, and FTL methods, verify shipment accuracy, routing, carton counts, pallet configurations, and warehouse destinations, while proactively monitoring shipment statuses and resolving discrepancies. Maintaining accurate shipment documentation and tracking records is a critical part of the position.



Shipment Cost Analysis & Reporting

The candidate will review and analyze placement fees, transportation costs, split shipment impacts, and cost-per-unit shipping metrics. They will identify opportunities to reduce costs and improve operational efficiency while preparing recurring shipment cost summaries and reports that support business decision-making.



Data & Inventory Management

Responsibilities include maintaining accurate inventory levels across multiple warehouses and ensuring data consistency across reports. The role requires advanced use of Excel and Google Sheets for reporting, analysis, forecasting, and shipment planning. Strong attention to detail and data accuracy is essential.



Logistics Coordination

The successful candidate will coordinate with warehouses, prep centers, freight carriers, and internal teams to ensure smooth shipment execution. This includes scheduling and monitoring pickups and deliveries, assisting with freight coordination, and communicating shipment updates, delays, and exceptions clearly and promptly.



Required Qualifications

Candidates should have hands-on experience working inside Amazon Seller Central and a strong understanding of Amazon shipment workflows. Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Excel and Google Sheets is required, along with strong analytical, organizational, and problem-solving skills. The ability to work independently, manage repetitive operational tasks with a high degree of accuracy, and communicate effectively in writing is essential. Candidates who are detail-oriented and follow instructions carefully tend to excel in this role. When submitting your application, start the subject line with **Capybara** followed by your name.



Preferred Qualifications

Experience coordinating FTL freight shipments, familiarity with freight portals and logistics software, and knowledge of inventory planning and supply chain operations are highly valued. Additional experience with SPS Commerce, EDI workflows, Amazon B2B operations, routing requests, ASN management, retailer compliance requirements, freight appointments, carrier communications, and Vendor Central workflows will be considered an advantage.

title: Marketing Operations & SEO  VA
description:
JOB OVERVIEW



ROLE SUMMARY



We are hiring a Marketing Operations & SEO Execution VA to own day-to-day marketing execution across SEO, website content,
 marketing (Brevo), campaign coordination, and reporting.



We're a small, tight team. Our other VAs have been with us 3+ years, and we're looking for a long-term teammate to grow with us — not a slot to fill.



The role is full-time, long-term, with a paid 4–6 week ramp at part-time hours (20–25 hrs/week) so you can learn our systems. If you're capable of carrying the role at that pace, we scale you to 40 hrs/week from there. Strategy and high-level priorities come from management and an SEO expert. You own implementation, monitoring, coordination, and follow-through. Over time, you are expected to need less guidance, not more.



This is not a junior VA role and not a freelance SEO consulting gig.



KEY RESPONSIBILITIES



On-page SEO & website execution (core)





Implement on-page SEO on PrestaShop (titles, meta descriptions, headings, internal linking, alt tags, basic QA).

Upload, format, and optimize content across category pages, product pages, FAQs, and blog posts.

Monitor Google Search Console and keyword tracking; spot trends and propose actions.

Coordinate with the SEO expert for audits, priorities, and review feedback.





Off-page SEO & backlink management (core)





Own the backlink building program: strategy, target list, prospect qualification, and placement QA.

Run outreach yourself when needed, and coordinate with an outreach specialist if/when one is added to the team.

Maintain the outreach tracker (prospect status, site DA, anchor text, outcome) and report monthly on placements and link quality.





Content creation & QA (AI-assisted, core)





Draft, optimize, and improve SEO content using AI tools (ChatGPT, Claude) and SEO content tools (e.g., SurferSEO, Frase, or similar).

QA AI-generated content for accuracy, brand fit, and SEO performance before it goes live.

Improve existing category/product copy, FAQs, and blog posts. We have a content writer for long-form, but you'll handle short content and AI-assisted optimization.

We use AI as a workflow tool, not a shortcut. Comfort with AI-assisted content is expected and welcomed.





 marketing & automations (Brevo)





Manage ongoing campaigns and automations. 

Monitor performance, maintain list hygiene, run basic testing/optimization.

Research,  propose, and implement new automations as the program matures.





Campaign & calendar management





Own the marketing calendar — what gets published/sent and when, within agreed priorities.

Turn high-level ideas into schedules, briefs, and deliverables.

Coordinate with Creative/Social and content contributors to hit deadlines.





Reporting & coordination





Track key SEO/email/campaign KPIs and maintain a Looker Studio dashboard.

Report what's actually useful — no vanity metrics.

Keep workflows, documentation, and calendars organized.





REQUIREMENTS





3+ years in digital marketing, SEO execution, or marketing operations.

Hands-on SEO implementation on a CMS/e-commerce site.

Hands-on experience with Brevo, Klaviyo, Mailchimp, or similar.

Comfortable with GA4 and Google Search Console.

Ability to write, edit, and improve SEO-friendly content (categories, products, FAQs, blog) — including AI-assisted drafting and QA.

Strong written English, reliable execution, self-managed — we don't micromanage.





NICE TO HAVE





PrestaShop experience.

Looker Studio.

Experience with AI content tools (SurferSEO, Frase, Clearscope, Jasper, etc.).

Backlink outreach track record (cold outreach, guest post placement, partnership links).

Experience with regulated/compliance-sensitive products (botanicals, supplements, skincare).





THIS ROLE IS NOT





A basic VA/admin role.

A "just upload and follow checklists" role.

A freelance SEO consulting role with multiple clients.

A job where everything is spelled out step-by-step forever.

An affiliate program or loyalty system management role (these sit elsewhere on our team).





HOW TO APPLY (REQUIRED)



Please answer these in your application. Missing answers will be skipped.





Why are you a good fit for this role specifically?

Describe an SEO or marketing execution task you owned end-to-end. What did you do and what did you track?

Give an example where you noticed a trend/problem in data and took action.

Which tools have you used (CMS, GA4/GSC,
 platforms, SEO tools, AI content tools)? What did you personally do in them?

How do you use AI tools in your content workflow? Walk us through one example.

Optional but preferred: share one example of SEO content you wrote or improved. If you can't share links, describe what you did and the results.

Include the word compounding in your reply so I know you read this carefully.





ROLE DETAILS





Full-time long-term position. Starts at 20–25 hrs/week for the first 4–6 weeks, scaling to 40 hrs/week once you're up to speed on our systems.

4+ hours/day of overlap with CET working hours required. Async-friendly outside the overlap window.

Deadline reliability is essential.

The Role

We're hiring a Sales Development Representative to make outbound calls to small home-service business owners across the United States. Your one job: get them interested and book a short discovery call with our founder. - Real comfort and confidence on the phone. You like talking to people.

- Reliability and consistency. You show up for every scheduled call block.

- Sales or appointment-setting experience is a plus but not required if the phone presence is there.



Working Hours

This is a part-time role (~25 hours/week) on a set call schedule in US Central Time (Dallas, TX). Reliable availability during scheduled US CST call blocks is required.



Compensation

- $400–$550 USD/month depending on experience (salary, paid directly). This is a part-time role (~25 hours/week) with room to grow into full-time as we scale.



TO APPLY — voice recording required (no exceptions)

"Hi, is this the owner? My name is [your name], and I'm calling from Always Answer. title: GoHighLevel + Video & Social Specialist — Grow a US Eye-Ophthalmologist Clinics

Remote · Part-Time or Full-Time · US Ophthalmology Group (Florida) Part-Time $350–$450 USD/week · Full-Time $700–$900 USD/mo — plus uncapped new-patient bonuses that can DOUBLE your pay.





Read this first

This is not a VA job. We're hiring one elite operator to run our marketing engine and grow it — someone who lives in GoHighLevel and produces video and social content that stops the scroll and gets patients to call. Part-time (4–5 hrs/day) to start, with a fast path to full-time for the right person.



You already have the gear: the right computer, the pro software, the editing skills. You can turn out a steady stream of polished, persuasive content — real footage enhanced with AI, never fake AI avatars or voices. And you know how to make that content actually convert through GoHighLevel.



If you're world-class at both, keep reading. If you've only "heard of" these tools, this isn't your role — and that's okay.





Why the best apply here

Part-Time $350–$450 USD/week (4–5 hrs/day) or Full-Time $700–$900 USD/mo. Top performers move up fast.

Uncapped bonus: $[AMOUNT] for every qualifying new patient your work books and shows. The bonuses add up fast — drive 35–50 patients in a month and your bonus can rival, or beat, your base.

Bi-weekly pay via Wise. On time, every time.

13th-month bonus after 12 months. Paid US holidays + paid leave after probation.

Direct access to the CEO and marketing lead. No five layers of management. Your work is seen and rewarded.

Clear path to Operations / Marketing Manager within 12–18 months.



Your pay is the floor. Your ceiling is set by you.





The role in one sentence

You own our GoHighLevel CRM end-to-end and produce the video and social content that brings senior and diabetic patients through our doors — and you get paid on every patient you help bring in.





What you'll do

GoHighLevel (the backbone) Build workflows from scratch — patient recall, new-patient intake, no-show recovery, review requests, referral program. Manage pipelines and tags, build SMS/email sequences (US copy supplied — you execute and polish), set up calendars and lead routing, and build dashboards: leads ? calls booked ? patients shown.



Video & social (where you shine) Create and edit scroll-stopping short-form video for YouTube, Reels,
, and TikTok — content that gets adults 65+ and diabetics to pick up the phone. Run our organic social across all platforms, targeting a 15–20 mile radius around each of our three offices. Film, cut, caption, and publish warm, human content built on real doctors, staff, and consented patients. Track what works and make more of it.



Paid ads support (Meta) Daily Ads Manager checks, launch and duplicate creative, pull weekly reports. You execute under direction — but you must know Meta Ads cold, including Special Ad Category (Health & Wellness) rules for US healthcare.



Reporting Weekly Monday snapshot to the CEO. Build SOPs as you go so the system never depends on one person.





Must-haves (don't apply without these)

2+ years hands-on GoHighLevel — real workflows you built, not templates you clicked.

Proven short-form video + social skills — a portfolio of content that performed.

1+ year live Meta Ads (Google Ads a plus). Health & Wellness category experience is a bonus.

Excellent written and spoken English.

Reliable internet (25 Mbps+), quiet workspace, working webcam.

Long-term mindset. We hire for years. Job-hoppers get cut early.



Nice-to-have: US healthcare experience, HIPAA awareness, Zapier/Make, Canva/CapCut, patient-recall or booking-funnel experience.





Schedule

Start part-time at 4–5 hrs/day, with a fast path to full-time for the right person. Live overlap required: 9:00 AM–2:00 PM US Eastern (9:00 PM–2:00 AM Manila), Mon–Fri, for real-time work with the CEO and marketing lead. Beyond the overlap, your hours are flexible — we measure output, not clock time.





About us

A stable, established US ophthalmology group with three Florida clinics treating thousands of patients a month — focused on senior eye health, diabetic eye disease, and advanced retinal care. Small in-house marketing team, real budget, real tools. Not an agency. Not a startup that might vanish.





How to apply (this is your first test)

We get hundreds of applications. This is how we find people who actually read.



Subject line, exactly: CLEAR VISION — GHL + Video Specialist — [Your Name]



In the body, in this order:



Codeword "20/20" at the very top.

3 GoHighLevel workflows you built — 1–2 sentences each: the problem and the result.

2 video/social posts you made — links + results (views, saves, calls, leads).

1 Meta or Google campaign you ran — niche, monthly spend, what you optimized for, result.

Years of GHL + years of video/social + years of Meta Ads.

A Loom (3 min max) walking through one workflow inside your own GHL account. Required — no Loom, no review.

Your full-time monthly rate in USD (part-time hourly if relevant).

Earliest start date + hours of US Eastern overlap you can commit to.



Anything missing = automatic rejection.





Hiring timeline

Applications reviewed daily · Shortlist within 5 business days · Round 1: 30-min Zoom with the marketing lead · Round 2: paid 2-hour test task (you keep the pay even if not hired) · Final: 20-min call with the CEO · Offer within 2 weeks.



We're hiring one excellent person. Apply properly — and welcome to a role where the harder and smarter you work, the more you earn.

description:
We are looking for a reliable, detail-oriented virtual assistant from the Philippines to help manage our short-form content operation.



We run a high-volume content system for a fast-growing app. We post a lot of short-form videos across TikTok and Instagram, and we are planning to scale to many more accounts soon.



This role is not mainly about creating content from scratch. The content is usually already made inside our internal content studio. Your job is to help organize it, upload it, schedule it, post it, check that everything goes live properly, and keep the whole posting system running smoothly.



This is a part-time role to start, with a path to full-time for the right person.



What you will do



Your main tasks will include:



* Uploading and scheduling TikTok and Instagram posts

* Posting content from our internal content studio

* Using our posting software to manage multiple accounts

* Making sure each post goes out on time

* Checking that posts actually went live

* Marking posts as posted in our tracking system

* Using captions that are already written, and sometimes making small caption edits

* Adding hashtags when needed

* Choosing the correct sounds for TikTok and Instagram posts

* Organizing content files in Google Drive and spreadsheets

* Reporting errors, failed posts, account issues, or anything that looks wrong

* Checking account health and making sure accounts stay active

* Occasionally scrolling TikTok/Instagram to understand trends, sounds, and account behavior

* Following clear SOPs and checklists carefully



You will be using tools like TikTok, Instagram, 
, Google Drive, spreadsheets, and our internal content studio.



Who this is for



This role is a good fit if you are:



* Very detail-oriented

* Reliable and consistent

* Good at following instructions

* Comfortable doing repetitive tasks accurately

* Fast to report problems instead of hiding mistakes

* Good with checklists, spreadsheets, and content systems

* Comfortable working with TikTok and Instagram

* Interested in social media, short-form content, and growing accounts

* Hungry to learn and prove yourself



Experience with social media management is a plus, but it is not required if you are sharp, careful, and willing to learn.



Schedule



We are starting with around 15 hours per week.



The ideal schedule is a few hours per day with some overlap with European daytime hours. This will likely be afternoon/evening time in the Philippines.



There may also be some light weekend work, since posts need to go out on weekends too. This will be discussed clearly before starting.



Pay



This is a paid part-time role.



We will start with a 2-week paid trial. If the trial goes well, this can become a long-term part-time role, with the opportunity to grow into a full-time Content Operations Manager role as we scale.



There may also be monthly bonuses when the content operation performs well and posts are managed properly.



Important qualities



Please do not apply if you are not comfortable with detailed operational work.



This role requires accuracy. Small mistakes can create problems, for example:



* Posting the wrong video to the wrong account

* Missing a scheduled posting time

* Forgetting to check if a post went live

* Using the wrong caption or sound

* Not reporting an issue quickly

* Not following the checklist



We of course know that mistakes can me made, which is normal, but  it is important to  handle the mistakes properly and  make sure that it doesn't happen again.



We are looking for someone who takes responsibility and communicates clearly.



How to apply



To apply, please send:



1. A short message explaining why you are a good fit for this role

2. Your previous experience with TikTok, Instagram, VA work, or social media management

3. Your expected hourly rate

4. Your availability in Philippines time

5. A 1-2 minute Loom video introducing yourself



In your Loom video, please answer these questions:



1. Why do you think you would be good at a detail-oriented content operations role?

2. Tell us about a time when you had to follow a process carefully.

3. What would you do if a scheduled post failed to publish?

4. Are you comfortable working part-time first, with the chance to grow into full-time later?



Applications without a Loom video will not be reviewed. We want to get a feel for who you are as a person in the loom video.



Please do not send a generic copy-pasted AI written proposal, we can see through that. 



Shortlisted candidates may be invited to complete a small paid trial task that is similar to the real work.

title: Social Media Video Editor (Direct Response & Motion Graphics)
description:
Social Media Video Editor (Direct Response & Motion Graphics)

Location: Remote

Type: Full-time

Platforms: TikTok, Instagram Reels & Stories, YouTube (long-form + shorts)



The Role

We’re hiring a high-level video editor who specializes in direct-response, high-retention social video.

Your job is to take direct-to-camera footage and turn it into scroll-stopping, performance-driven edits using pacing, sound design, motion graphics, and visual storytelling.

This is not passive brand content.

This is aggressive, fast-paced, conversion-oriented video inspired by top-performing VSLs and short-form ads.

You should already know what great looks like — and be excited to push edits hard. If you need heavy hand-holding, this won’t be a fit.



What You’ll Be Editing

Direct-response short-form ads (9:16)

VSL-style social videos

Talking-head sales content with heavy visual support

Long-form YouTube content ? repurposed into high-impact shorts

Quality > quantity.

We care about hooks, retention, clarity, and persuasion — not “pretty edits.”



What You’ll Be Responsible For

• Editing long-form videos and repurposing them into high-retention short-form clips

• Creating motion graphics, kinetic typography, UI mockups, and visual callouts

• Designing pattern interrupts (cuts, zooms, text, B-roll, SFX) to hold attention

• Using sound design intentionally (hits, whooshes, risers, impacts, UI sounds)

• Maintaining fast pacing with zero dead air

• Visually amplifying:

Claims

Proof

Contrast

Risk reversals

• Making strong editorial decisions with minimal direction

• Delivering clean, on-brand edits with minimal revision cycles



What This Role Is NOT

Not a bulk hook/CTA swap role

Not template-only editing

Not a subtitle-only position

Not slow, cinematic, or documentary-style editing

Not a role with constant step-by-step instructions

If you need heavy hand-holding, this won’t be a fit.



Requirements

2+ years editing social-first or performance-driven content

Strong portfolio showing talking-head videos with motion graphics

Advanced proficiency in Adobe Premiere Pro

Working knowledge of After Effects (required)

Strong sense of pacing, typography, and visual hierarchy

Comfortable editing for retention and persuasion, not just aesthetics

Ability to think in terms of hooks, beats, and viewer psychology



You Will Love This Role If…

You enjoy bold, aggressive pacing

You obsess over the first 3 seconds

You like editing ads more than cinematic montages

You think sound design is as important as visuals

You want autonomy and trust, not micromanagement



The Quality Bar

You should be capable of editing at this level (or better):



Our internal style references include Hormozi-style VSLs, EyeFly-style edits, and high-performing short-form ads.



How to Apply

Please send:

Your resume (or brief background) - 

A link to your portfolio or showreel

Highlight 2–3 examples of short-form, talking-head, or direct-response content with motion graphics
