title: Hiring: AI Content Operator — $15–25/hr, remote, contractor
description:
Hiring: AI Content Operator — $15–25/hr, remote, contractor



The setup



.



I've already got an audience and a funnel running — YouTube and Instagram content that turns into free-course signups and 30-day GoHighLevel trials. (Some of us have started calling this "Claude for Content" — you'd be the one actually running it day to day to get things made and out the door.) The ideation and the content pipeline are mine — I'm deeply involved in that part, every week. What I need is someone to take it from there: build the automations, generate the actual content with AI, get it edited, and get it posted, on time, without me having to chase it.



.



The role at the simplest level



You're doing three things every single day. Taking the ideas and scripts that come out of our content pipeline and actually producing them — AI-generated, B-roll, whatever the format calls for. Getting each piece edited, mostly through AI tools, and out the door on schedule, whether that's an automated post or you hitting publish yourself. And repurposing what's already live into the next thing — same content, new platform, new cut.



.



Why I'm hiring



That's the floor. The reason I'm posting this is I'm not handing off ideation — that part's staying with me and the pipeline I've already built. What I want is someone who can take a script and a hook and actually turn it into a finished, edited, posted, and repurposed piece of content without needing their hand held through it. Execution brain, every day. We'll still go through the analytics together — but production can't bottleneck on me.



.



Who we are



I'm Vico Khang. I build and run AI automation and no-code agency systems on GoHighLevel — AI voice and chat agents, lead-gen automations, white-label SaaS — on real client accounts, not just talking about it on camera. The content side grew out of that: people kept asking how I was doing it, so I started filming it, and that turned into a real audience on Instagram and YouTube. We're not a media company that picked up automation as a topic. We're an automation business that happens to also make good content about it. Want the longer version, in my own words? Watch it here: 



.



How to apply Fill out the doc here: 



.



Day to day



Building and maintaining the automations that move content from script to published post, cutting out manual busywork wherever it can. Generating the actual content with AI tools once a script or idea comes down the pipeline — B-roll voiceover pieces, AI-avatar or UGC-style videos, whatever the format calls for. Editing through AI tools first, and stepping in by hand only where AI can't get it there. Posting on schedule, automated where it makes sense, manual where it doesn't. Repurposing everything that goes out on YouTube or Instagram into TikTok, LinkedIn, and
 versions. Flagging anything in the calendar that needs a second look, and looping me in on the numbers — we go through those together.



.



What I need



Real, hands-on fluency with Claude and the broader AI content stack — Gemini, Higgsfield, HeyGen — enough to take a script or idea and actually produce a finished piece with it.



Comfortable building simple automations — Zapier, Make, n8n, or native tool workflows — so posting and repurposing don't need a human clicking every button.



Solid editing instincts, and just as important, knowing which AI tool can do the edit for you and when it can't.



Real, hands-on posting experience on YouTube and Instagram — you know the upload mechanics, scheduling, and formatting quirks of each platform cold.



Comfortable repurposing long-form into short-form without needing a brief for every single cut.



Decent English. We're filming for a US, UK, Canada, and Australia audience.



.



Bonus



If you've actually run the production and distribution side of a channel — your own or someone else's — and know what breaks when you try to automate posting and repurposing, that's a big plus.



.



What won't work



Someone who wants to own the ideation and strategy — that's staying with me and the content pipeline. Someone who treats AI tools as optional instead of the default way things get edited and produced. And someone who needs a fresh brief for every single piece instead of running the system once it's handed to them.



.



How to apply Fill out the doc here: 



Please don't send me a generic resume with nothing to show how you actually produce content with AI — I'll know within 5 seconds, and I'll just close it.

title: Virtual Sales Representative - US Market
description:
We are a growing US-based Tax and Accounting firm looking for a results-driven Virtual Sales Representative based in the Philippines.



Job Title: Virtual Sales Representative - US Market - Remote

Salary: $400 - $650 (USD) per month (Freshers Welcome to Apply)

Job Type: Full-Time (40 hours/week)

Shift: US (EST - 9 am to 6 pm)



What You’ll Do (Responsibilities)

1. Drive Growth: Proactively reach out to leads via outbound calling to introduce our expert tax and accounting services.

2. Qualify & Convert: Conduct discovery calls to identify business pain points (e.g., high tax bills, messy books) and effectively pitch our solutions.

3. Master the Close: Guide prospective clients through the on-boarding process and turn "interested" leads into signed contracts.

4. CRM Management: Maintain an organized pipeline using our CRM, ensuring timely follow-ups and detailed notes.

5. Stay Sharp: Learn the basics of the US tax landscape (training provided) to speak authoritatively with business owners and CEOs.



Who We Are Looking For

1. The Closer: You have 1+ years of experience in B2C outbound sales, appointment setting, or telemarketing (US-based experience preferred).

2. The Communicator: Your English is near-native, both written and spoken. You can hold professional, high-level conversations with American business owners.

3. The Problem Solver: You don’t just read a script; you listen to the lead and adapt your pitch to solve their specific problems.

4. The Pro: You have a reliable home office setup (high-speed internet, noise-canceling headset, and power backup) and are comfortable working US business hours (EST).



How to Apply

 1. Please send your application with the subject line: "Virtual Sales Representative Rockstar - [Your Name]".

 2. Attach your updated resume.

 3. Include a brief 1-2 minute video introduction (Loom preferred), introducing yourself and explaining your experience with Western clients.

title: Creator Outreach Specialist
description:
About the Role:



M2 Energy is a premium powdered energy drink brand based in the United States. We are building our creator affiliate network across Twitch, Kick, YouTube, and TikTok and need a reliable, self-motivated outreach specialist to help us grow it.

This is not a rigid, checklist-driven role. We need someone who can think on their feet, handle real conversations with creators, and represent our brand with professionalism, warmth, and confidence. If you are looking for a role where you follow a script and nothing else, this is not the right fit.

What You Will Do:



Find and qualify content creators across Twitch, Kick, YouTube, and TikTok

Reach out to 100 creators per day using our approved outreach messages

Handle creator responses, answer questions, and manage conversations through to the point of sign-up

Log all activity accurately in Airtable every day

Ask for guidance when you are unsure rather than guessing



Who We Are Looking For:



Prior experience with creator or influencer outreach

Fluent in English — written communication must be professional, friendly, and warm

Comfortable thinking independently and using judgment in real conversations

Reliable internet connection and consistent availability Monday through Friday

Airtable experience preferred

Someone who takes ownership of their work and does not need constant supervision



What We Provide:



Complete onboarding documents covering everything you need to know

Approved outreach scripts and response guides

Full Airtable access

Dedicated M2 Energy
 account

Direct access to the founder for questions and guidance



Schedule:



Monday through Friday

Approximately 4 to 5 hours per day

100 outreaches per day minimum — 500 per week



Rate: Starting at $3 per hour, negotiable based on experience and performance

To Apply:



Tell us about your experience with creator or influencer outreach, what platforms you have worked on, and why you are a good fit for this role.

title: Social Media VA
description:
Here’s a quick video sharing why you may want to work with me! 
 



Role Overview:

I’m looking for a proactive, highly organized Social Media Virtual Assistant to become a key partner in managing the day-to-day content operations of my business. In this full-time role, you’ll take ownership of executing and organizing social media content across multiple platforms, handling content creation and video editing, uploading and publishing posts, and maintaining content calendars so I can stay focused on high-priority initiatives. You’ll be responsible for keeping content flowing smoothly, ensuring brand consistency, tracking performance metrics, and proactively managing weekly workflows with minimal oversight. This role is ideal for someone who thrives on structure, enjoys behind-the-scenes execution, and wants to grow long-term as an integral part of a values-driven, high-performing team.



Requirements:

*Must be able to work US hours.

*Strong written and verbal communication

*Highly organized, detail-oriented, proactive, and able to manage multiple priorities independently.



What You’ll Do:



Must-Have Experience (Responsibilities You Must Be Proficient In):



These are the tasks the VA needs to handle independently and confidently from day one:



Social Media Management:

*Schedule and publish content across platforms such as Instagram,
, TikTok, LinkedIn, and YouTube

*Write, edit, and proofread captions, hashtags, and post descriptions

*Ensure posts are published on time and aligned with content calendars

*Monitor comments, messages, and notifications; flag or respond as directed



Content Creation & Organization:

*Handle content creation and video editing for social media platforms

*Create content assets, including graphic design and short-form video edits

*Organize content assets (videos, graphics, captions) in shared folders

*Take long-form video content and repurpose it into short-form formats such as Reels, Shorts, posts, and stories

*Ensure brand voice, formatting, and posting guidelines are followed



Content Calendar Management:

*Create, set up, maintain, and update content calendars as needed

*Align publishing schedules across platforms to ensure consistent posting



YouTube Management & Optimization:

*Manage YouTube content, including uploading videos, writing captions/descriptions, and adding tags

*Create and optimize YouTube titles, descriptions, thumbnails, and metadata

*Apply YouTube optimization (SEO) to improve visibility and discoverability

*Ensure YouTube content aligns with brand voice and content strategy



Analytics & Reporting:

*Track performance metrics and analytics (reach, engagement, views, clicks)

*Prepare weekly or monthly performance summaries

*Identify top-performing content and engagement trends



Nice-to-Have Experience (Responsibilities You Can Learn Over Time)



These tasks are valuable but can be trained on the job:

*Support paid ad setup, monitoring, or reporting (Meta Ads, YouTube Ads)

*Community management and engagement strategies

*Basic video editing (reels, shorts, captions, thumbnails)

*Canva design for social media graphics and templates

*Influencer outreach or collaboration coordination

*SEO optimization for social captions, YouTube titles, and descriptions

*Assisting with content strategy planning and campaign execution

*Knowledge and familiarity with AI tools for content creation, research, analytics, or workflow optimization



Ready to Apply?

1. Message me with the subject “I am your Social Media Virtual Assistant!”

2. Add a link to your resume

3. Indicate your contact
 address



If this doesn’t sound perfect but you love hard work and learning, reach out anyway—there’s likely another chance to join my team!

As part of this role, you will verify that business names and opening hours are correct. You will check that the distance from a starting point to an end destination is listed accurately, resulting in better user experiences.



With this job you can plan your days around this highly flexible working schedule, work weekends or late evenings, all from the comfort of your own office. title: BUSINESS DEVELOPMENT & PARTNERSHIPS MANAGER / Luxury Fashion | B2B Sales | Global Growth
description:

You will work directly with the founder and become one of the key people behind the international expansion of the company.



Fashion Runs Through Your Veins

You follow designer brands, fashion weeks, luxury trends and beautiful products. You notice details, craftsmanship, styling and presentation.



You do not simply work in fashion.



You live it.

Operations & Growth

Requirements

* Excellent English

* Notion

Send the following via WhatsApp:




. CV

title: 3D Animator & Cinematic Artist  (Intern to Mid-Level)
description:
Remote | Contract to Full-Time



About Us

We are a woman-owned creative studio based in Los Angeles, California working with VTubers, streamers, content creators, and digital brands.



Our focus is building internet-native media including VTuber content, animated videos, creator branding, motion graphics, promotional content, virtual production, and interactive digital experiences.



We are a small but growing studio that values creativity, collaboration, initiative, and artistic storytelling. We are looking for a talented 3D Animator & Cinematic Artist who can help bring environments, stories, virtual productions, and creative concepts to life through animation, cinematography, lighting, and visual storytelling.



This role will start as contract work with the goal of transitioning into a long-term full-time position as the studio grows.



This is a fully remote position with opportunities to collaborate internationally with creators, agencies, game developers, and animation studios.



What You Will Be Creating

Projects may include:

• Animated cinematics and promotional videos

• VTuber intros, trailers, and creator content

• Stylized 3D environments and virtual worlds

• Motion graphics and visual storytelling sequences

• Virtual production and mocap-based content

• Cinematic social media content and advertisements

• Unity-ready scenes and interactive experiences

• Environmental storytelling and world-building assets

• Lighting, mood, atmosphere, and visual presentation for creator projects

• Marketing videos, teasers, and launch campaigns



Required Responsibilities

• Create high-quality 3D animations, cinematics, and story-driven visual content

• Design and build stylized environments, props, and scene layouts

• Develop lighting, atmosphere, mood, and cinematic presentation for projects

• Create camera movements, shot compositions, and visual storytelling sequences

• Translate storyboards, scripts, references, and creative briefs into engaging animated content

• Assist with pre-production planning, shot development, and production workflows

• Produce cinematic renders and promotional visuals for creators and studio projects

• Prepare scenes, assets, lighting setups, and animations for Unity workflows when required

• Collaborate closely with video editors, graphic designers, audio engineers, developers, and content creators

• Participate in creative reviews and contribute ideas during concept development and production meetings

• Maintain organized project files and efficient production workflows

• Follow creative direction while helping elevate the overall visual quality of projects

• Communicate progress effectively and work independently in a remote environment

• Create believable character performances, body language, and movement for cinematics, promotional videos, shorts, and creator content

• Animate characters performing realistic actions such as walking, running, dancing, interacting with props, and expressing emotion through movement

• Create engaging camera movements, shot transitions, and cinematic sequences that enhance storytelling and visual impact

• Understand pacing, timing, and scene composition to create professional-quality animated content

• Develop lighting, atmosphere, mood, and cinematic presentation for projects

• Translate storyboards, scripts, references, and creative briefs into engaging animated content



What We Are Looking For

• Experience with Blender, Autodesk Maya, or similar 3D software

• Strong understanding of animation principles, timing, weight, and movement

• Understanding of cinematography, camera language, shot composition, and visual storytelling

• Experience creating stylized environments, scene layouts, and environmental storytelling

• Understanding of lighting, atmosphere, mood, and color theory

• Ability to work from storyboards, scripts, concept art, references, and creative briefs

• Understanding of production pipelines and asset organization

• Ability to receive and apply creative feedback effectively

• Strong communication and collaboration skills

• Reliable communication and ability to work remotely

• Ability to manage deadlines and multiple creative projects simultaneously

• Strong understanding of animation principles, timing, weight, balance, and character movement

• Ability to create natural, believable human motion and performances

• Understanding of dance animation, body mechanics, locomotion, and physical movement

• Understanding of cinematography, camera language, shot composition, lens selection, and visual storytelling

• Ability to create dynamic camera movement while maintaining clarity and visual appeal

• Understanding of scene pacing, shot sequencing, and cinematic editing principles

• Experience creating content intended for videos, VODs, trailers, promotional content, and social media clips

• Strong eye for visual storytelling, motion, and presentation



Preferred Software Experience

• Blender

• Autodesk Maya

• Adobe After Effects

• Adobe Premiere Pro

• Substance Painter

• Adobe Photoshop

• Unity

• Unreal Engine (Bonus)

• DaVinci Resolve (Bonus)

• ZBrush (Bonus)



Bonus Skills

• Virtual production experience

• Motion capture cleanup and retargeting

• Environment art and world building

• Storyboarding and pre-visualization (Previs)

• Cinematic editing and trailer production

• Unity VFX and shader creation

• Experience creating anime-inspired content

• VTuber industry experience

• Character animation and facial animation

• Basic scripting knowledge for Unity

• Character modeling, rigging, and avatar creation (Plus but not required)

• VRChat, Warudo, or VTuber production experience

• Motion capture cleanup, retargeting, and performance enhancement

• Dance choreography animation

• Facial animation and lip-syncing

• Virtual camera operation and cinematic sequencing

• Experience directing animated scenes or cinematics

• Experience with music videos, trailers, promotional videos, or VTuber content production



Portfolio Requirements

Applicants must provide examples demonstrating:



• Animation and cinematic work

• Environment creation and scene composition

• Lighting and mood development

• Camera work and visual storytelling

• Rendered portfolio pieces or completed video projects

• Storyboard, previs, or production planning examples (if available)

• Proof that the applicant personally created the showcased work



Portfolios that only contain static models without animation, cinematic work, environment creation, or storytelling examples may not be considered.



Growth Opportunity

We are looking for someone interested in growing with the studio long-term.



As the company expands, this role can evolve into:

• Associate 3D Animator

• Junior Cinematic Artist

• Senior 3D Animator

• Senior Cinematic Artist

• Lead Virtual Production Artist

• Art Director



Compensation

Compensation ranges from $0.40 to $5.00+ USD per hour, depending on experience, portfolio quality, technical skills, artistic ability, and overall fit for the role.



This position is expected to average approximately 20 hours per week (80 hours per month) during the initial contract period. Based on this schedule, compensation ranges from approximately $32 to $500 USD per month.



The role will begin with a three-month trial contract period. Additional hours and responsibilities may become available based on performance, project needs, and studio growth.



We are looking for tea
mbers interested in growing with the studio long-term. Outstanding contributors may be considered for compensation increases, expanded responsibilities, leadership opportunities, performance bonuses, training opportunities, and future full-time positions as the company continues to grow.



Outstanding contributors may receive bonuses, training opportunities, and leadership responsibilities.



How to Apply [Please read]

Please submit your portfolio (required) and tell us:



• A VTuber, animation, game, or cinematic project whose visual style you admire

• What specifically you like about its animation, storytelling, cinematography, environment design, lighting, or presentation

• How you would approach creating a similar scene or cinematic sequence



Do not use AI to apply. Applications generated primarily through AI may be disqualified.

Do not apply if you do not have experience creating 3D animation, cinematics, environments, or visual storytelling content.

title: AI-Powered Digital Marketing Manager
description:
Tri-Wellness (
) is a holistic wellness brand founded by Lisa Shanken — an executive functioning coach, certified health counselor, personal trainer, and yoga instructor. Our mission is to help people live healthier, more harmonious lives through a whole-person approach that connects the gut, brain, body, and daily habits. We work mostly with neurodivergent adults and those navigating mental health challenges, meeting every client with warmth, practicality, and zero judgment.



Our core services include:



Executive Functioning Coaching: One-on-one coaching focused on skills like time management, emotional regulation, organization, and impulse control



Social Bloom: A structured group program that helps adults build meaningful friendships and social skills in a supportive, confidential setting



Love Bloom: Neurodivergent-friendly speed dating and connection events reimagined to feel safe, low-pressure, and genuinely fun.



Your Role



Based on our proven success in Colorado, we are expanding to New York City with plans to grow nationally. You will architect and lead our AIdigital marketing strategy across social, content, paid,
, and B2B channels leveraging AI as a core operating layer, not an afterthought.



B2C marketing will include attracting and converting leads into coaching clients, Social Bloom group members, and Love Bloom event attendees. B2B marketing will include building Lisa's credibility and visibility within the professional and B2B community to generate referral partnerships with therapists, psychologists, psychiatrists, and other allied health professionals and communities; and supporting the recruitment of coaches as we expand into new geographic markets.



This role is for someone who builds AI tools to support our growth goals and initiatives. You'll own the AI strategy end-to-end: identifying where intelligent automation, AI-assisted content production, analytics, and personalized outreach can unlock growth, and then implementing those systems in close collaboration with our Content Manager, dev team, and executive team.



Work Environment & Job Details



You have your own home work environment

Willingness to work at least 4+ hours per day between 9am-5pm MST

We provide guaranteed 100% on-time salary payments

We are hiring immediately



What You'll Do



AI Strategy & Systems Architecture 



This is the backbone of the role. You will:

Audit our current marketing workflows and identify the highest-leverage opportunities for AI integration

Design and implement AI-powered systems across content production, paid media, B2B prospecting,
 automation, and analytics

Recommend, evaluate, and own our AI tool stack, from LLMs and workflow automation platforms to data enrichment and personalization tools

Collaborate with the Content Manager, dev team, and executive team to ensure AI-driven outputs align with Lisa's voice, brand values, and growth objectives

Stay current on emerging AI capabilities and proactively bring new strategies to the table



B2B Outreach & Referral Development



Build and execute an AI-assisted prospecting system targeting therapists, psychologists, psychiatrists, and aligned wellness professionals in the NYC market and beyond

Use AI tools for lead mining, contact enrichment, personalized outreach sequencing, and follow-up automation at scale

Develop and manage LinkedIn marketing strategies to grow Lisa's visibility and credibility within the professional community



 & Automation



Build and manage automated messaging flows, lead tagging, list segmentation, and A/B testing

Leverage AI to personalize messaging at scale and optimize deliverability and engagement

AI-Forward CRM: Consultation, platform selection (or custom AI-build), setup, configuration, implementation



Paid Meta Advertising



Audience development, budget and bid management, retargeting, and creative performance analysis

Use AI-assisted tools for creative testing, audience modeling, and ROI optimization



Social Media Marketing



Demonstrated ability to drive social media engagement

Demonstrated ability to drive direct response actions (sign-ups, registrations, inquiries, referrals)



Landing Pages & Funnel Development



Strategy and coordination with the Content Manager and web development team

Build and manage full-funnel architecture (TOFU/MOFU/BOFU) with AI-informed optimization at each stage



Tracking & Analytics



UTM, GTM, and GA4 tracking across all organic, paid,
, and referral touchpoints

Performance reporting with AI-assisted insight generation and clear communication to the team



What We're Looking For: 



3–5 years of digital marketing experience, ideally in wellness, mental health, or coaching

Demonstrated ability to architect and implement AI-driven marketing systems. This is a hard requirement, not a nice-to-have.

Proven track record using AI across at least two of the following: content production, paid media optimization, B2B prospecting and outreach, marketing automation, or analytics

Ability to evaluate and recommend AI tools independently, then execute on your recommendations

Genuine comfort with topics like mental health, neurodiversity, executive functioning, and holistic wellness

Self-directed, organized, and accountable to own outcomes, not just tasks

Strong communicator who can translate AI strategy into clear, collaborative direction for a small team



Nice To Have



Personal or professional connection to the neurodivergent community

Experience marketing to or communicating with healthcare or mental health professionals

Background in health coaching, integrative nutrition, or a related field

Experience growing a personal brand or thought leadership platform

SEO: on-page, Google Search Console, technical SEO

Experience with Google Ads, TikTok Ads, or display advertising



Why This Role



This is a rare opportunity to do work that genuinely matters, and in a way that's at the frontier of how modern marketing gets built. You'll have real ownership across our entire marketing operation, with the freedom to design intelligent systems from the ground up. And you'll be doing it in service of a brand with real heart: one that's helping neurodivergent adults find connection, confidence, and community.



If you're someone who sees AI not as a shortcut but as a multiplier, and you want to put that capability to work for something meaningful, we'd love to meet you.

title: Claude Content Mananger - $25/hr USD
description:
Hiring: AI Content Operator — $15–25/hr, remote, contractor



The setup



.



I've already got an audience and a funnel running — YouTube and Instagram content that turns into free-course signups and 30-day GoHighLevel trials. (Some of us have started calling this "Claude for Content" — you'd be the one actually running it day to day to get things made and out the door.) The ideation and the content pipeline are mine — I'm deeply involved in that part, every week. What I need is someone to take it from there: build the automations, generate the actual content with AI, get it edited, and get it posted, on time, without me having to chase it.



.



The role at the simplest level



You're doing three things every single day. Taking the ideas and scripts that come out of our content pipeline and actually producing them — AI-generated, B-roll, whatever the format calls for. Getting each piece edited, mostly through AI tools, and out the door on schedule, whether that's an automated post or you hitting publish yourself. And repurposing what's already live into the next thing — same content, new platform, new cut.



.



Why I'm hiring



That's the floor. The reason I'm posting this is I'm not handing off ideation — that part's staying with me and the pipeline I've already built. What I want is someone who can take a script and a hook and actually turn it into a finished, edited, posted, and repurposed piece of content without needing their hand held through it. Execution brain, every day. We'll still go through the analytics together — but production can't bottleneck on me.



.



Who we are



I'm Vico Khang. I build and run AI automation and no-code agency systems on GoHighLevel — AI voice and chat agents, lead-gen automations, white-label SaaS — on real client accounts, not just talking about it on camera. The content side grew out of that: people kept asking how I was doing it, so I started filming it, and that turned into a real audience on Instagram and YouTube. We're not a media company that picked up automation as a topic. We're an automation business that happens to also make good content about it. Want the longer version, in my own words? Watch it here: 



.



How to apply Fill out the doc here: 



.



Day to day



Building and maintaining the automations that move content from script to published post, cutting out manual busywork wherever it can. Generating the actual content with AI tools once a script or idea comes down the pipeline — B-roll voiceover pieces, AI-avatar or UGC-style videos, whatever the format calls for. Editing through AI tools first, and stepping in by hand only where AI can't get it there. Posting on schedule, automated where it makes sense, manual where it doesn't. Repurposing everything that goes out on YouTube or Instagram into TikTok, LinkedIn, and
 versions. Flagging anything in the calendar that needs a second look, and looping me in on the numbers — we go through those together.



.



What I need



Real, hands-on fluency with Claude and the broader AI content stack — Gemini, Higgsfield, HeyGen — enough to take a script or idea and actually produce a finished piece with it.



Comfortable building simple automations — Zapier, Make, n8n, or native tool workflows — so posting and repurposing don't need a human clicking every button.



Solid editing instincts, and just as important, knowing which AI tool can do the edit for you and when it can't.



Real, hands-on posting experience on YouTube and Instagram — you know the upload mechanics, scheduling, and formatting quirks of each platform cold.



Comfortable repurposing long-form into short-form without needing a brief for every single cut.



Decent English. We're filming for a US, UK, Canada, and Australia audience.



.



Bonus



If you've actually run the production and distribution side of a channel — your own or someone else's — and know what breaks when you try to automate posting and repurposing, that's a big plus.



.



What won't work



Someone who wants to own the ideation and strategy — that's staying with me and the content pipeline. Someone who treats AI tools as optional instead of the default way things get edited and produced. And someone who needs a fresh brief for every single piece instead of running the system once it's handed to them.



.



How to apply Fill out the doc here: 



Please don't send me a generic resume with nothing to show how you actually produce content with AI — I'll know within 5 seconds, and I'll just close it.

title: Architectural Designer & 3D Visualiser — Modern Bungalow Redesigns + Marketing Renders
description:
Overview

We're a UK digital agency working on behalf of a property developer marketing two self-build bungalow plots. Planning consent and approved drawings are already in place — we now need a skilled architectural designer/technician who can modernise the internal layouts and produce 2D and 3D marketing visuals that help prospective buyers picture the finished homes.



You'll work from the existing approved location plans, site block plans and floor plans (all provided). The footprint and external envelope of each property are fixed by the existing planning consent and must not be exceeded — the creative freedom is in the internal layouts and the quality of the presentation.





The two plots

Plot 1 — 2-bed bungalow



Rectangular footprint, approx. 61 m² / 656 ft²

Currently a 2-bed layout

Needs: a modern internal redesign with a few alternative layout options, plus one option reconfigured as a 3-bed — all strictly within the existing footprint.



Plot 2 — 3-bed bungalow



Larger L-shaped footprint

Currently a 3-bed layout

Needs: a modern internal redesign with a few alternative layout options. The client is open to suggestions on additional rooms and layout changes — within the existing footprint.





Scope of work / deliverables

For each plot:



Updated location plan (based on the existing one provided)

Individual site block plan

2D floor plan redesigns — modern layouts, with a few internal options to choose from (Plot 1 also needs the 3-bed variant)

3D drawings + photorealistic rendered images so buyers can visualise the finished home



Plus: 5. One combined site block plan showing Plots 1 & 2 together 6. Any suggested extras that would strengthen the marketing (e.g. furnished room renders, external/street-view shots, floor plan staging) — ideas welcome.



External spec (from existing drawings): 30° roof pitch, Redland Grovebury slate-grey roof tiles, bungalow form. Final material palette to be confirmed with us.





What we'll provide

Existing approved location plans (1:1250 / 1:500)

Existing site block plans (1:500)

Existing floor plans for both plots (1:50)

Site, access and any further detail on request





Skills & experience required

Proven residential architectural design / drafting (UK experience preferred)

Comfortable working within an existing/approved planning footprint

Strong CAD skills (AutoCAD, Revit, ArchiCAD, SketchUp or similar)

3D modelling & photorealistic rendering (Lumion, Enscape, Twinmotion, V-Ray or similar)

Track record of sales/marketing-grade property visuals

Clear communicator with good written English



A single freelancer who can deliver both the technical drawings and the renders is ideal, but we'll also consider a designer + visualiser pairing.





To apply, please include

A short note on your relevant experience

A portfolio showing residential floor plans and 3D renders

The software you'll use

Your fixed price for the full scope above (or day rate + estimate)

Your estimated timeline and availability

Confirmation you're happy to work within the existing planning footprint

title: Creative Specialist
description:
About the Role: 



We're looking for a creative and detail-oriented Creative Specialist who is also skilled in video editing and imagery. This role is ideal for someone who can bring stories to life through both motion and static visuals while leveraging modern creative tools.

A key part of this position is working with AI image and video generation platforms, so candidates must have experience creating effective prompts and directing AI-generated content to achieve specific creative outcomes. You should understand how to translate creative concepts into detailed prompts that produce high-quality visual assets, videos, and design elements.

You'll work closely with our team to create engaging content for digital platforms, marketing campaigns, social media, and advertisements.





Responsibilities:



Edit high-quality video content for social media, marketing, and promotional campaigns.

Create and enhance visual assets, graphics, thumbnails, and imagery.

Develop motion graphics, animations, and visual effects when needed.

Collaborate with the creative team to maintain brand consistency across all content.

Organize project files and manage multiple editing projects simultaneously.

Utilize AI-assisted creative workflows to improve production speed and quality.

Stay updated on trends in video production, visual design, and AI-generated content.





Requirements: 



Strong proficiency in:

*Adobe Premiere Pro

*Adobe Photoshop

*Adobe After Effects

Solid understanding of video editing, pacing, storytelling, and visual composition.

Experience creating compelling imagery and graphic assets.

Knowledge of color correction, audio editing, and motion graphics.

Strong attention to detail and ability to meet deadlines.

Portfolio showcasing both video editing and visual design work.



Nice-to-Have Skills: 

Experience with AI-powered creative tools and workflows.

Familiarity with:

*Google Veo

*OpenAI Sora

*Other AI image and video generation platforms

Experience with content creation for social media, advertising, or e-commerce brands.

Basic understanding of photography, visual design, and branding.

What We're Looking For

Creative thinker with strong visual instincts.

Self-motivated and capable of working independently.

Open to learning and experimenting with new technologies and AI tools.

Passionate about creating high-quality visual content that drives engagement and results.



To Apply, please submit:

1. Your resume

2. Portfolio or demo reel

3. Examples of visual design work (graphics, imagery, thumbnails, etc.)

4. A brief note describing your experience with AI creative tools, if applicable



Only applicants with complete requirements will be reviewed and considered.
